s.desc:
新特工、新威胁、新史诗战役
《Sniper Elite: Resistance》提供无与伦比的狙击机制、潜行和第三人称战术战斗，将这一获奖系列的关注点转向了一场远离前线、深入被占领的法国腹地的隐秘战争。
在与《Sniper Elite 5》并行展开的扣人心弦的新故事中，特别行动执行处(SOE)的特工哈里·霍克首次担任主角，他发现了一种阴险的新型奇迹武器——这种武器威力强大，足以确保纳粹赢得战争。
与法国反抗军合作，势必摧毁帝国武器库中的这一致命武器。
多个暗杀名单目标以及不同的潜入和撤离点为你提供了无与伦比的选择权，让你自由决定如何完成目标并创造出自己的游戏风格。
整个战役也可以在合作模式下进行。与盟友一起对抗纳粹战争机器，分享武器、物品和战术知识，并在交火中倒下时互相帮助重新投入战斗。
逼真的X射线击杀镜头和先进的枪战物理效果
标志性的X射线击杀镜头回归，展示每一次标志性射击的真实破坏力。骨头会使子弹偏转方向，不可预测地从新的路径穿透敌人的身体，而冲锋枪和手枪也会触发击杀镜头，以夸张的慢动作展示多发子弹射击。
要成功击中目标，你需要像真正的狙击手一样思考。在瞄准目标时，要考虑步枪枪托和枪管的选择，同时还要考虑重力、风和心率。
真实的二战武器和自定义
你可以使用的武器库将包括回归的系列游戏热门武器，以及一系列全新的二战真实武器。挑选合适的装备对于粉碎帝国的邪恶计划至关重要！
根据你的作战风格自定义武器。找到分散在战役各处的工作台，以使用新瞄准镜、枪托、枪管、弹匣等自定义和升级你的步枪、副武器和手枪。同时要记得为正确的任务选择正确的弹药，无论你需要的是穿甲弹还是非致命击倒。
宣传任务——加入反抗军
在主战役中找到独特的宣传海报，并在全新的宣传任务中扮演一名法国反抗军战士的角色。在这些情景中，潜行、狙击和击倒敌人，以完成限时任务，并帮助结束纳粹的占领。
轴心国入侵模式
广受喜爱的轴心国入侵模式回归了！以轴心国狙击手的身份入侵其他玩家的战役，参与致命的猫捉老鼠游戏。无论你是跟踪猎物、设下埋伏还是在枪林弹雨中奔跑，入侵的威胁都会为战役带来全新的挑战维度。
紧张的在线多人游戏
当你掌握了步枪后，自定义你的角色和装备，在竞争激烈的16人战斗中在线作战，以赚取经验值、奖章和勋带。
如果你不喜欢竞争，还可以在生存模式中与最多3名其他玩家组队对抗一波又一波的敌人。

critic.quote: Sniper Elite: Resistance is here, and it's not reinventing the wheel. It is the same craft that we've seen, with a more cheerful protagonist, in different locales. But that's not a bad thing, as Rebellion have only striven to improve the head-popping formula that they clearly care about. Another trip back behind enemy lines, Resistance is just as fun as any of the Sniper Elite's before it.

Sniper Elite: Resistance delivers more of the excellent tactical stealth shooting action that Sniper Elite 5 boasted three years ago. It might be a familiar experience, but for genre fans, it's still an easy recommendation.

Packed with that familiar caliber of intriguing level design and emergent gameplay, Sniper Elite: Resistance may not be the most radical of changes, but it undoubtedly makes up for it in its retaining the series’ joyous curating of tactile shots and careful planning alike.

Sniper Elite: Resistance is a reasonable continuation of the franchise, its sniping highs remain as amusing as ever thanks to some neat environmental gameplay, but much of its content rehashes what came before instead of evolving the series concept for a true next-gen sequel.

Resistance doesn’t introduce any major innovations, but it once again delivers a solid mix of action and mission planning, which is the Rebellion’s winning formula. However, the series can no longer rely solely on its signature cinematic kills to stay relevant. A general refresh, including technical improvements, is becoming necessary before the franchise risks slipping into a nostalgic more of th

Sniper Elite: Resistance serves as more of a stopgap than a full-blown sequel to Sniper Elite 5, so much of that experience — including its highs and lows — carries over two and a half years later. Its sniping action truly is elite, but the gunplay surrounding it still needs work. Equally, the Invasion Mode is again a standout while enemy AI remains frustrating at times. It is more of the same. critic.quote: Destiny 2 is an epic: a story with an ever expanding scale made greater by the heroes of whom the story is told with tragedy, struggle, and redemption. It is very fitting that the score to accompany it must be, too. And it is. There were moments that I had to put the controller down and simply listen, taking in the scope of what I was experiencing.

Lessons were learnt and learnt well. The looming Darkness has not consumed Bungie at this point in time. Quite the contrary. Destiny 2 is the glorious self-rez fans have been praying for. Stop orbiting it and dive in, today.
Destiny 2 improves upon its predecessor in every conceivable area, resulting in a content-packed, enjoyable FPS that will keep you entertained for months on end.

There’s a lot to enjoy here both solo and as a co-op experience. Any fan of Destiny 1 should take a look at this game, and anyone that has had interest in it but hasn’t pulled the trigger on it just yet should rest easy knowing that while it has a few issues here and there, Destiny 2 is a great game that champions over the first game in so many ways. I highly suggest it to both FPS and RPG fans al

Although Destiny 2 requires quite a lot of grinding, the whole process doesn't really feel like a chore since there are so many varied activities that you'll rarely do the same thing twice in a month (unless it's a weekly activity, or you really want to). First and foremost, Destiny 2 does not frustrate players by placing parts of the end game under hard to achieve power level requirements. There'

The story and gameplay mechanics have greatly improved, and it sports many graphical upgrades. It's unfortunate that the enemy AI isn't more challenging, but for this franchise, the fun will always come from the end-game content. As long as players understand and accept that, they should snap up this sequel and prepare for another long adventure.

通过重装上阵版和免费的《猩红纽带》DLC，获得更为丰富的《消逝的光芒2 人与仁之战》体验。请注意：DLC必须单独下载。
距离第一部游戏的故事已经过去了20年，病毒占了上风，人类正逐渐走向灭亡。你将扮演艾登·克拉德威尔，一个流浪漫游者，负责运送货物和传递消息，在被丧尸病毒摧毁的荒芜世界中，保持着与仅存的几个生存者聚居点的联系。然而，你的真正目标是找到妹妹米娅。为了逃离华尔兹医生的痛苦实验，你曾经离开了还是孩童的她。这段过去一直在你心中挥之不去。当你听说米娅可能还活着，并且居住在地球上最后一座城市维勒多时，你终于下定决心直面这一切。
不久后，你发现自己身处一个冲突不断的定居点。你需要参与新奇而残酷的战斗，不断磨砺自己的技能，击败成群的丧尸，并与其他人结盟。你将在城市中漫游，在维勒多的建筑和屋顶上自由奔跑，搜寻偏远地区的战利品，并在夜晚时保持警惕。每当太阳西沉，怪物就会占领所有街道。
末日后的世界
15年前，人类经历了一场大陷落，这场灾难永远改变了世界。到了2036年，只有为数不多的定居点存留于世，而人类正在逐渐走向灭亡，为无情的新物种——成群结队的丧尸——让路。
白天属于活人，夜晚属于感染者
白天，生存者仍然努力在这里生活，表面上看，一切似乎……不错。然而，当日落时分到来，一旦阳光消失，城市中更可怕的居民将占领街道。如果你在黑暗中停留太久，不提高警惕，就可能永远无法回家。
移动不止，生命不息
你不可能赢得所有的战斗。有时候，逃跑才是上策。幸运的是，你正好有这样的技巧。当你陷入危机，跑酷会让你顺利逃脱。在屋顶间跳跃，飞荡着穿过不同的城市景观等等。只要确保能够逃离夜晚的怪物。
残暴一点，再玩得花一点
在这个危险的世界中，只有最强者才能生存。无论你是喜欢粉碎、切割还是肢解任何挡在你面前的敌人，记得要发挥创造力！结合战斗和跑酷的方式抵御任何形式的危险，一切为了活命。
与其单打独斗，不如四个漫游者同行
有朋友相助，在维勒多活下去会更容易。与最多3名玩家组队，以增加你的生存几率。一起探索剧情，接受漫游者哨站的挑战，或是在城市街道上大肆破坏。

critic.quote: The best samurai game in a long time and a great fun for all, who love action. Love for Japan and its history is a big plus, but its knowledge is not necessary to enjoy every minute of this beautiful game. [Issue#305]

The world is enormous, filled to the brim with rich content to explore. It can be a bit much sometimes with the number of artefacts you can find or haikus to sit and devise bloating things a little bit, but players will be blown away by the deep storytelling and unbelievable style and personality that Ghost of Tsushima brings to the table.

Ghost of Tsushima ends the current generation of consoles on a high note. A fantastically gorgeous world sets the stage for high-stakes close quarters combat, with multiple enthralling stories told over many chapters that keep the player moving across the island. Core combat is rewarding, and while enemy AI is disappointing outside of combat, all other aspects of Ghost of Tsushima have been loving

A smattering of small niggles ultimately prevents Ghost of Tsushima from reaching the upper echelons of PS4 folklore, but it's still an absolute must for your game collection, and a fitting end to the PS4's line of exclusives. Ghost of Tsushima is a fantastic journey through the trouble and strife of 13th Century Japan and is complimented perfectly by a set of great characters, a likable main char
Ghost of Tsushima offers an amazing open-world experience and satisfying combat, only mildly held back by its writing and characters.

I was hoping for an original take on the open-world genre, but I got Assassin’s Creed in samurai drag. If that sounds like a blast to you, it will be, especially if you go into it with the knowledge of the game’s design missteps. It’s not that it’s bad - it’s just bad for me.

critic.quote: The stunning graphics, incredible survival horror combat and wonderfully eerie setting make picking up a copy of Resident Evil 2 a no-brainer.

Resident Evil 2 Remake is everything a remake should aspire to be. It captures the feel of the original almost perfectly while updating and improving almost everything. It has its flaws, but nothing detracts from the excellent experience. It's fun, spooky, and everything Resident Evil 2 was — but even better. Fans of the franchise and newcomers should enjoy themselves greatly. If you like killing
Resident Evil 2 plays its cards very well, and offers its benefits to a level of excellence that make this remake a title that's indispensable.

Resident Evil 2’s remake highlights just how great Capcom’s first sequel in the Resident Evil series ways, but does it in a way that makes it the most compelling entry in the series thus far. It’s smart changes merge with the classic design expertly, while its atmosphere is rich thanks to gorgeous lighting and incredible sound design. It’s a reminder of the past, but this remake would be a fine di

Aside from the disappointing 2nd Run scenarios, I feel confident in saying that this is the best Resident Evil game ever released. It brings back everything that fans loved from the PS1 classic, and presents it in a fresh, modern way that's both exciting and nostalgic in a modern age.
In spite of its progression carrying the weight of the years and its strongly cliche scenario, Resident Evil 2 remains an exciting game in its mode of thought, its inventiveness and its execution.

大逃杀
投入只有《战地风云》能提供的大逃杀模式，特色包括大规模破坏、快节奏的小队对战和大逃杀中最致命的收缩火圈。
快速大逃杀
大逃杀登陆拉斯维加斯。在全新禁区冲突模式“快速大逃杀”中，进攻就是一切。击杀敌人。赢取重新部署机会。空降多张地图，在人数更少的对局中展开激战，争夺装有游戏中顶级战利品的空投，并直面收缩速度最快的火圈。更多高光时刻。更猛烈的攻势。更快的比赛节奏。快速出击。

s.desc:
在《从军》游戏中，玩家不仅能够操纵单名士兵在一线拼杀，更能指挥一整支小队达成战术目标——《从军》是一款多人在线小队射击游戏，忠实还原了风云激荡的 20 世纪多场著名战役的战斗情景。游戏中每场战斗的规模多达上百人，双方均有大量坦克与空战单位登场，打造独一无二的大战场体验！
率领您的部队，为胜利而战吧！
独特小队机制
玩家将指挥自己的小队投入战斗，除玩家直接操控的士兵外，小队内其他单位均由 AI 控制。即使出现伤亡，玩家也能立即切换至小队内其他士兵继续战斗。
独特的小队玩法让从军能够营造真正的大战场氛围，忠实还原了第二次世界大战一线战斗的烈度与强度！
真实战场环境
身临其境体验战火世界中多条战线上的历史战斗：从炮火连天的太平洋岛屿，到诺曼底登陆后肃清村庄；从柏林街头帝国最后的困兽犹斗，到保卫莫斯科最危急的时刻；从热战正酣的斯大林格勒到突尼斯的漫天黄沙……
第二次世界大战主要参战国中有 4 个国家在游戏内登场：美国、苏联、德国与日本。玩家可以选择加入任何一个国家，组建技能多样、职阶专长各异的小队为胜利而战。游戏根据战斗的真实交战方分配交战国家，不同国家的参战部队装备有阵营专属的武器载具，士兵外观也做到了真实还原。
多兵种联合作战
在步兵装备之外，《从军》还囊括了坦克、装甲车、摩托车等一系列地面载具，还包括战斗机与轰炸机的空中力量。多达 400款载具涵盖了绝大多数玩家耳熟能详的二战装备，驾驭这些钢铁巨兽迈向胜利吧！
此外，坦克手与机组成员不仅能够操纵技术兵器，也是受过战斗训练的优质战士——载具严重损毁、除了弃车逃生难道别无他法了吗？乘员组还可以拿起武器与步兵一起战斗，他们的战斗力也不容小觑！
胜利之路
游戏内士兵共分为 18 个职阶，不同职阶的士兵拥有专属技能树与武器装备，不仅涵盖了传统轻武器，还包括了各类重型技术兵器如可架设的反坦克炮、重机枪与防空炮；以及包括火箭发射器、火焰喷射器、枪榴弹在内的多款特种装备。无论何种作战情境都有破敌之道！
多种特殊机制极大丰富了游戏玩法：您既可以选择从敌人侧翼发动突袭，也可以选择作为空降兵伞降至敌方防线后方，或是使用工程兵在前线建造工事与机枪阵地固守。实现战术目标的手段多种多样，通向胜利之路永远不止一条！

critic.quote: With all around fantastic gameplay, graphics, design, and just overall fun, I’d argue that under different circumstances, this could have even been considered a game of the year contender. I never realized just how much the Sony PlayStation had influenced my life until I played this game.

This is a huge surprise. A “free game” that’s actually better than many of those you have to pay for - and also the best showcase of the capabilities of the DualSense controller which has the potential to change how we experience video games.
Astro’s Playroom is a creative surprise. For the PS5 launch Asobi Team serves up a jump-and-run highlight – preinstalled!

As well as being an excellent demonstration of the future ahead for owners of the PS5, Astro’s Playroom serves as an excellent, albeit brief platformer. You’ll find that just as the game really begins to come into its own, it ends, and that’s an almighty shame, but will likely you leaving salivating at the prospect of what is to come for Astro Bot and friends.
Astro's Playroom is just that; a playroom for the next generation - a small glimpse into what the PlayStation 5 will be able to do with the DualSense.

Astro's Playroom, a game that makes no attempt to hide the fact that it is an excuse to show you what a gamepad can do, conjures a world that you will want to see and explore. More than that, its surprisingly delightful celebration of PlayStation and its video games is a great way to kick off a console generation.

critic.quote: Everything feels like a step forward, even though there are some aspects (like random tutorials or some situations in which we felt completely out of control) that we would like to see more polished. Still, a great choice for The Sims fans.

The Sims 4 simply has core-features. No pools, no garages and other important stuff... Expansion Packs are coming. The Sims 4 has weak content, AI is problematic and it's definitely the worst The Sims game ever.
I think it is a better foundation to build on than The Sims 3 had at launch.

The Sims 4 manages to be both the worst and the best installment in
the series so far. It’s lacking content and has a fair amount of
glitches and bugs. But the new feeling mechanics works really well,
and opens up a new dimension that The Sims never have been close to
before. In the end, the positive parts are the ones that are most
noticeable.

The new generation of Sims begins with what feels like a bare-bones starter kit. It packs top-of-the-line Sims creation and house building tools, but styling options and activities are distinctly lacking. Add the contents of its first expansion, and Sims 4 will probably feel like the game it should be right now.
The Sims 4 takes a step forward in some ways, while taking two steps back in others.

critic.quote: Overwatch 2 plays brilliantly. It’s a wonderful shooter full of depth, with unique heroes to master, maps to learn, and hours of your life to lose all over again.

Overwatch 2 is a worthy successor to the original Overwatch that doesn’t so much reinvent the wheel as it does improve upon it. While it does have its issues, the core gameplay and improved UI make for a fun and fully realized sequel.

Overwatch 2 simply exists in an awkward transition phase between the game it was and the game it wants to be. It's not a revolution by any stretch, at least not how the original game was, but it's still Overwatch and that means it's still a ton of fun.

It’s difficult to look back on a game like Overwatch and wonder what it could’ve been if it had been delayed, and released as a complete, full-priced package with none of the extras: no feel-bad Battle Passes, with the story mode and Hero Missions available to all from the get-go. It’s not all doom and gloom of course; I’ve been in denial about the change in direction for PvP, but tens of hours of

This is, really, a relaunch dressed up as a sequel, although the game remains as fun as ever. Some balancing issues and, of course, a questionable progression system hinder the potential of Overwatch 2.
Overwatch 2 is as fun and fast-paced as the original game, but its free-to-play structure sullies the experience a bit.

critic.quote: Fall Guys is an extremely addictive and accessible fun for the entire family. It is hilarious even when you are losing terribly, which makes it the biggest hit of the summer and possibly also the winter ahead of us. [Issue#306]
A breath of fresh, bright and breezy air after a summer of hard-hitting AAA’s, Fall Guys cements itself as an essential addition to your party library. Believe the hype.

Fall Guys balances frustration and enjoyment perfectly, handing you victory at the expense of someone else whilst snatching it away from you just as much. Despite some irritating, luck-based team games, Fall Guys is a one of a kind experience that will only get better season to season. It's the most fun I've had with a game in years.

If Fall Guys can keep up its current momentum with a steady stream of skins and minigames, I see no reason why it can’t be one of the top contenders in the battle royale genre. It’s got the charm, the fun gameplay, and the multiplayer communituy focus that’s as fun to watch as it is to play, and these beans don’t seem to be slowing down anytime soon.
Full of cute and cuddly jellybean dude bumbling into each other in a race for the crown, Fall Guys is just about the most wholesome battle royale imaginable, and a whole lot of fun.
Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout is a game that bets on simplicity and entertainment, with very good sensations and awaiting tweaks that enhance it even more.

critic.quote: Aniimo is the next big thing. From the incredible creature designs to a world filled with life and magic, there’s just so much to enjoy. There’s a little something for everyone here, although sharing that with people can be a bit cumbersome. Aside from the usual mobile game problems and some UI issues, the game is a great experience. The monetization isn’t too bad, and there’s no gacha for the Ani

The open world stands out for bringing the distinct personalities and ecology of over 200 Aniimo to life. Capturing, Twine, and elemental interactions naturally tie collection and exploration together, though the simplistic combat and lack of polish leave something to be desired. Even so, the game remains highly accessible.

At least for the moment, Aniimo cannot even remotely be considered a "Pokémon killer," as it lacks the fundamental elements needed to truly challenge the GameFreak series—most notably the complete absence of a competitive mode worthy of the name. That said, the adventure crafted by Pawprint Studios is a joy to play and will keep you glued to the screen for hours as you hunt for every creature and

Aniimo is a charmingly detailed live service game with a creature collection system, which is simple on the surface and as deep as the player wants to dive into it. With a focus on exploration, collection and housing, players who want a challenging creature battler may find it lacking, but for everyone who enjoys exploring pastel-coloured worlds along fluffy creatures, Aniimo is worth a look.

Aniimo is a fun free-to-play creature collector with engaging real-time combat and quite a bit of content to explore. The creature design is fantastic, and the world is a beautiful space to explore. The story isn’t earth-shattering, but it keeps things moving along. While you’ll engage with some of the lighter F2P elements each day, none of it ever hinders your progress or stonewalls your experien

Aniimo offers a compelling creature-collection experience, successfully capturing the essence of its inspirations while introducing innovative mechanics like regional variants and divergent evolutions. critic.quote: Even without a museum to sate that historian interest, Capcom Arcade Stadium is a fantastic compilation. The game list has a nice mix of familiar classics and hidden gems, with the usual quality of life touches, rotating special challenges to keep things fresh, and charming, nostalgic presentation. It’s also the collection that finally brought the bullet hell masterpiece Progear to console, and th

While I did miss the classic cabinets in each title, there are still plenty of frames and other display options to choose from. Next to an actual arcade, Capcom Arcade Library will give you the retro gameplay you’re looking for and may even save you a few quarters along the way.

All in all the Capcom Arcade Stadium is a lovely little package. Whether you are an old-timer like me who reminisces over their mis-spent youth, or someone who would like to explore the earlier days of gaming, Capcom’s legacy as a maker of fine arcade games is here for all to see.

Overall, Capcom Arcade Stadium is a very good package filled with brilliant games, each updated with modern functionality. It doesn’t rival the quality of original hardware or the likes of M2’s sublime individual ports of arcade masterworks as seen with the release of Esp.Ra.De Psi, but at £30 for 32 games, it is well worth the price, warts and all.
Capcom Arcade Stadium provides a generous bunch of golden-age arcade titles (with a little too much Street-Fighterism), paired with a vast assortment of options and gorgeous presentation.

Capcom Arcade Stadium is an essential purchase for fans of retro gaming. Loaded with a ton of content, this game will keep newcomers and returning gamers entertained for hours. Although there are a few titles and features missing, this collection is still a fantastic addition to your Nintendo Switch library.

critic.quote: If you enjoy pinball in any shape or form, Zen Pinball 2 is a must download.
From Soho down to Brighton, it's the best videogame version of pinball you'll find.

Zen Pinball 2 is the game for the more casual fan, but pinball enthusiasts will also have a great time, despite the physics not quite being 100% realistic. The buttery smooth 60fps in 1080p also does wonders for the experience and this is the best version of a Zen made pinball game yet.

The great pinball simulator we already know arrives on PS4 letting us download all the tables we've already purchased on PS3 and PS Vita versions. There's no new additions, but the experience is as good and addictive as it is on other platforms.
As it stands, the game is a fun romp, but only if you can get past the differences from real pinball psychologically.

After its enjoyable outings on previous platforms, Zen Pinball 2 has arrived on the PS4 in good form. Assuming that you can get past the inflexible purchasing options and cut through the sometimes overwhelming digital gloss, you’ll find a flipping fun game with an addictive core at its steel-coated centre.

激烈的团队战斗
在HEAT中投身激烈的5对5小规模战斗和更大规模的10对10冲突，在这里，个人能力和团队协作都至关重要。这里没有“一键胜利”的捷径；战场对每个人都一视同仁，胜利属于那些善于沟通、随机应变并用智谋战胜敌人的玩家。战斗、胜利、失败、掌握新技巧，并在每场新的战斗中变得更强。
人机协作

自主研发的引擎
HEAT采用从头设计的全新引擎，全面支持最先进的光照系统、粒子效果和视觉特效。每一次爆炸、撞击和战斗能力都会让玩家身临其境。
尖端科技的世界
HEAT的故事背景设定是战后的架空时间线，在这个世界里，科学是制胜的关键，科技奇迹遍地开花。但和平是脆弱的，在和谐的表象之下，潜藏着一场愈演愈烈的军备竞赛。您的武器库将配备各种尖端科技，这些科技产物全都基于现实生活中的科学与设计概念。这些“架空”设定的机械沉重、无情，为撕裂敌方装甲而生。在这个世界中，工程学的杰作将在前线战斗中大放异彩。

critic.quote: World of Tanks: HEAT is a bold reinvention of a franchise that many players probably didn't expect to see move in this direction. Turning World of Tanks into a hero shooter could have easily felt forced, but Wargaming has managed to create something that feels surprisingly natural once you're actually in a match.

World of Tanks: HEAT from developer Wargaming Group Limited is a good F2P game that offers fun modes, good customization, and a short stint of good MP matches. While the vanilla version of this game isn’t quite packed with a huge variety of modes, it still is a good way to have some dumb fun.

World of Tanks: HEAT successfully reimagines Wargaming’s classic tank warfare as a faster, more accessible tactical vehicle shooter. Its Agents, abilities and objective-based modes give the formula a welcome hero-shooter edge, although its long-term appeal will depend on balance, progression and post-launch support.

World of Tanks: Heat is a solid entry in the WoT franchise. The free-to-play model with premium paid options is a great way to bring new players into the fold and won’t risk pricing people out by costing an arm and a leg just to get started. With lots of agents and tanks to unlock and upgrade, World of Tanks: Heat is a well that will not run dry any time soon.
World of Tanks: Heat has potential rooted in fast-paced, visually impressive battles. However, right now it feels more like an open beta missing crucial and inexplicably omitted features.

World of Tanks: Heat stands out as a stylish tank shooter featuring hero classes that add depth and variety. However, the team-based gameplay across the various modes constantly oscillates between slow and tactical pursuit and fast-paced action, without ever fully committing to either.

critic.quote: Disney Speedstorm establishes a very interesting, fun and promising structural base. If it is not a revolution in the genre, it knows how to rely on the rich universe of Mickey's house IPs and does so in a pleasant, immersive and seductive way, leaving to be seen whether, in the near future, the business model adopted here will be adequate (or not) for the platform and audience to which it is dedi
Speedstorm has truly conveyed the Disney-Pixar essence into a videogame. Good first season, even though the progress in game and the rewards system lack that Disney magic.

Disney Speedstorm, even in its early access form, is shaping up to be a great kart racer that can shape up to other top-tier titles within the genre. With plenty of challenges, racers, and modes to try out and unlock, completionists out there have a multitude of reasons to hop into the game again and again while burning rubber as your favourite Disney or Pixar character. While the sheer amount of

Disney Speedstorm is certainly “on a roll” with its electrifying stages and game design, but it’s certainly not “undefeated.” The confusing microtransactions pull it down and become an annoying distraction to what’s great in this kart racer. While a love for the Disney product is certainly present in Disney Speedstorm, there are a few annoying aspects of the game to be mindful of.

Overall, Disney Speedstorm is a good kart racer. The overly complex in-game economy and lack of Grand Prix or other modes outside of single races may push some gamers away, and I wouldn’t blame them. At its core, this solid kart racer does just enough to make it worth checking out, but it won’t be challenging the title of Mario or Crash any time soon.

Disney Speedstorm is a fun game that we're glad to see has quite a bit of quality to it. There are some reservations about how well the free-to-play monetisation will work as we move forward, but looking just at the game itself, it’s not a bad time. 你的极限由想象力决定。

critic.quote: The Finals has given me some of my favorite multiplayer moments in 2023. Whether actively engaging in vertical combat or excitedly scaling rooftops on the way to the next objective, navigating the environments feels incredible, and the thrill of watching the ground disappear from below my feet never gets old. In a year of groundbreaking video game releases, The Finals is yet another highlight.

The Finals is the kind of game that you play when you want to live an action film. You’ll most definitely find a playstyle you like in one or more of the three classes. While there are too many factors outside of player control to consider this a truly high-level competitive game, it sure is a fun time. That being said, if you’ve been disappointed by recent FPS titles, then try The Finals for some

Hellishly fun multiplayer action, standing on a well-executed class system and the destruction of everything around. It excels in both aspects. Whether you're running on walls to send enemies back to respawn with an automatic shotgun or breaking through the floor to send a guarded safe to another floor, these are some of the best gaming moments you can experience with friends. It's just a shame th
Bombastic fun: The Finals cannot be categorized as an online shooter. And that is really refreshing.

The Finals offers an easy-to-learn FPS playground with a strong visual identity and some of the best destruction tech I’ve ever seen. Time will tell whether it can keep an audience, but right now it’s slick.
With loadouts to assemble and coordinated teams laughing to the bank, every breath of The Finals’ destruction does justice to its game show ambitions.

critic.quote: Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium's more eclectic offering is excellent. With a familiar presentation, array of extras, and wealth of options; it's a fitting follow-up to last year's incredible collection of arcade treasures so if you enjoyed that then definitely play this, too.
Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium might not be as essential as its predecessor, and you might wonder why these games couldn’t have just been delivered as DLC, but it’s still a fantastic retro collection.

Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium shouldn’t have much difficulty finding an audience. For folks like me who grew up in the arcades, there are plenty of nostalgic hits here that will motivate a purchase. Thankfully, gamers can purchase titles individually or as a full collection. It might be hard to justify buying the whole collection if you already own Capcom Fighting Collection. This was poor planning on
The emulation is perfect and it has many display options and unlockables. Its value, of course, depends on how nostalgic we are.
Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium once again delivers the experience of visiting an arcade with tons of great titles; this collection is sure to be a good time.

For those who merely dabble in arcade classics, then the way to go may be to hand-pick the games you want to play and checkout with a cheaper cart in hand. There are some real highlights in this collection that would be a shame to miss out on for a gamer of any flavor.

critic.quote: Dead or Alive 6 is amazing. It’s the best looking fighting game out there, bar none, and has a combat system that is both instantly accessible for newcomers, without feeling condescending, and yet also offering plenty of depth and complexity for experienced fans. It’s not perfect; the story mode is enjoyable but slightly undercooked, and one suspects that we’ll have to wait until pretty deep into

Dead or Alive 6 is a mechanically solid and foundationally sound fighting game. At its core, playing matches with others is a fun and thrilling experience that’s easy to grasp if you’re new to fighters or the series. Its lack of modes, however, coupled with its small roster, and a recently revealed $92 season pass raise a lot of questions as to what ideals drove the game’s development. For those l

Dead Or Alive 6 is still a very good fighting game which allows instant fun, even for a novice player, but you'll need serious skills to defeat a seasoned player. We only regret long, loading times and a weird storyline.

Dead or Alive 6 serves up great fighting mechanics, solid offline mode variety, and looks good while doing it. If you're a fan of the series, it's well worth checking out, even as this latest entry stumbles in the online arenas and the disappointing approach to customization.

Ultimately, I’m not sure if Dead or Alive 6 is the game that fans expected after a seven-year wait, but with its thrilling combat and amazing visuals, it still serves up a fulfilling experience — fanservice and all.

Dead or Alive 6 has a lot going for it – solid combat mechanics and an incredible tutorial mode being the elements that stands out the most – but overall it feels a little too bland and lacking in content to stand out in the sea of great fighting games of yesteryear.

critic.quote: It's undeniable to say that Marvel Rivals beat every odd stacked against it, and that's purely based on merit alone. It's a fun team-based shooter with new and old ideas featured prominently throughout its 33-character roster that kept me wanting for more.

Marvel Rivals is a rare example of a live service launch done right. Some aspects might feel more derivative, but the promise of future content that'll build on what's already a solid foundation is proof that Marvel Rivals is here to stay.

Even if you have never cared for hero shooters, I urge you to give this one a try. It's free-to-play, and if you have any love for superhero properties you'll find a character you love among this motley bunch. It is certainly inspired by games that came before, but its fast, frenetic pace and secret strategic weight make it something completely different. Like a sidekick growing into his mentor's

One free game leads to another, Marvel heroes and villains are welcome if the goal is simply to have fun. Between questionable balance and general lack of originality, some will turn up their noses, but how fun is Marvel Rivals.

Marvel Rivals takes on the bold challenge of building upon the foundation laid by Overwatch and adding its own unique spin--and it largely succeeds. With solid overall quality, accessible mechanics, and a wealth of content, the game feels primed for long-term success and has already captured the attention of a massive audience. Its enduring popularity is a testament to its strong design and engagi
Marvel Rivals is not a perfect game, it does not bring novelty and innovation to the playing field. It's just a clever use of branding, and it's fun to play as your favourite characters.

critic.quote: Warframe brings a new and addicting experience to the PlayStation franchise. Along with great and fluid combat, this is a free-to-play title that will justify microtransactions in a positive way.

The core gameplay, including the variety of suits and weapons, is terrific, and it’s reason enough to play this sci-fi shooter. But the boring story, too-similar missions, and aggressive payment model hold it back from what it could be.
If you can live with the pervading sense of confusion, there’s a lot of game here for no money. Whether it convinces you to part with some cash or not, you’ll still keep coming back.
Warframe, which has been out for PC since March, is free-to-play on the PS4, and in spite of its bugs, is worth the no-cost price.

The freedom of movement and cooperative combos make Warframe an entertaining coop game. Unfortunately, that only really counts if you're willing to spend money on it. Warframe is not only very misleading, but would improve from the extra content. The restrictive free-to-play model isn't working in Warframe's favor.
It's free, it's fine, and it's instantly forgettable. [Issue#143, p.104]

critic.quote: Despite high hopes and low expectations, Infinity Nikki manages to far exceed and surpass my vision for a AAA venture into Miraland, giving just about anyone interested something to do.

Infinity Nikki is a fantastic game, and you can play it while avoiding most of the gacha elements. It's a great gacha game that doesn't require you to pay any money to it to be able to succeed. It's a game full of whimsy, wonder, and most importantly dressing up and being able to customize Nikki to your liking, depending on the outfits you collect.

For me, the key word of Infinite Nikki is "surprise". I didn't expect that dressing up and the open world would have much chemistry together, but the result is that even if it doesn't seem possible, if both sides are done well enough, then it can be done! Whether it is the unforgettable story performance in the game or enjoying the jump level while exploring the world, these contents are interesti

Nikki caught my attention with its strong sense of identity, immediately standing out as something different than anything else it overlaps with on paper. Sure, you can easily connect some dots back to Genshin Impact or Zelda to name a few, but those elements are used to build a journey that has markedly different interests and goals. Infinity Nikki doesn’t reinvent any wheels, push boundaries, or
Visually stunning, but gameplay-wise shallow Free2Play game about fashion.
What Infinity Nikki lacks in difficulty, it makes up for with a gorgeous wardrobe and charmingly scenic world I can't stop poking around.

The kid gloves have been taken off to give us a complex, deep game full of exciting plays and powerful combos, but presented in a sensible and readable way, free from Joey Wheeler shoutin' about da heart o' da cards. Whether you're a veteran duelist, a lapsed player, or someone who's had a vague interest at some point in the last 25 years, this is th

Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel is an awesome game that Yu-Gi-Oh! fans, both new and old would love. I honestly would've probably given this a lower score, but they just added the option decks from YGOProDeck directly to the game. This just fixes one of the major issues of the game and warrants it a better rating. All in all, fantastic looking graphics, and it plays well. What else can you really ask from a

Konami managed to make the best Yu-gi-oh adaptation to this day that will bring many surprises to both old and new players because this game isn’t the same one we used to play 15-20 years ago. The learning curve is huge and it requires a lot of time to learn all the decks currently available, so be ready for a lot of grinds.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel is a free to play game designed for those who have been active in the card game for years and are looking for a space to measure themselves against other duelists from around the world. It's a deep game, with over 10,000 cards and updated rules. It's also addictive and a lot of fun, but less experienced players will struggle as they adjust to competitive play.

Master Duel is the pinnacle of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG in virtual form. It offers a ridiculous amount of tools to assist in deck customisation, and easily lets you obtain any of the thousands of cards. Where it currently falls short though is the matchmaking options, as there’s just so many variables at play from day one. This isn’t a game for new players, but it doesn’t try to be, so if you know your B

By its proposal, Duel Master clearly distinguishes itself from Duel Links, the other free-to-play in the universe of Yu-Gi-Oh!. By focusing solely on the playing card game, the title offers a very complete experience with official rules and a huge collection of cards on all media thanks to cross-platform.

Its distinctive art direction balances realistic textures with stylized characters, while strategic combat, well-structured building and production systems, and solid optimization come together without any obvious weak points.

Arknights: Endfield confidently showcases its strengths in art direction, character design, and world-building, while also making a bold move by introducing automation-focused construction systems. This experimentation inevitably brings along some rough edges and shortcomings, but that very sense of dissatisfaction reflects the game's willingness and sincerity in trying to offer something new.

Arknights Endfield is an ambitious spin off that successfully transforms the tower defense roots of the original into a semi open world action RPG with meaningful factory building systems and generous launch content. For a free-to-play game, Arknights: Endfield offers a wealth of well-made content. The factory building, tower defense mechanics, exploration, and team-based combat elements offer engaging hours of play, certainly worth the price of admission for fans of those genres. Arknights: Endfield is a beautiful addition to the gacha genre that stands out by blending a complex factoring-building simulation with an enticing open-world RPG. s.desc:
《异环》是Hotta Studio自主研发的超自然都市开放世界RPG。故事将从海特洛市启篇，作为首位「无证上岗」的「异象猎人」，你将成为接取民间异象委托维持周转的古董店「伊波恩」的一员，与个性迥异、能力非凡的伙伴们一起探索各城市的大小谜团，历经有笑有泪的各式奇遇，演绎独属于你们的都市物语。
【怪奇都市，异能冒险】
欢迎来到鉴别生涯第一站——生机勃勃、自由开放的海特洛市！
「异象管理局」大厅排队申领居民许可证的「歧骸」们面露憧憬，电车站台前一个响指清洁好自己通勤套装的「异能者」上班族行色匆匆。街这边正上演着鸡飞狗跳的抓捕「团三郎」的好戏，而另一头，巷尾休假的银边手套「管家」可能正与二手电器店的老板亲切攀谈……举目满是「异常」有趣的画面！
想要更了解这个人类与超自然存在密不可分的世界？那就从海特洛市开始切身见证、感受、记录！活泼搞怪的日常生活亦是波澜壮阔的冒险。
【妙趣正片，轻松串联】
今日头条：传闻中只有每月月中夜晚才会现身的神秘当铺？你又能为自己的愿望留下怎样的抵押？
号外号外：塔吉多恋情大危机！浪漫与冲动，心碎与错过！暗恋的塔可小姐即将随担保人搬离海特洛市，在那之前，纯情海獭该如何将自己的心意传递？！
可靠小道消息：照相馆「菲林轨迹」现已恢复营业！「伊波恩」古董店的全员特享专属折扣！
插播一条天气快讯：异象「雨人」进入活跃期，请务必携带雨具出行~
——今日的「10AM」就为你播报到这里。
另有频频交手的神秘异象，牢不可破的「誓约」伟力，「环」这一庞然大物的身影也在支离现世的「预言」回响中愈加清晰……
更多内容，还请由你亲自出演——这些独属于你的剧集篇章。
【同频邂逅，羁遇结伴】
冷清小巷里的神秘店铺，深藏不露的神秘店长，武力值超高的冷酷保镖，「万能机器人」式管家，总跟麻烦事脱不了干系的闯祸精们，还有进食方式成谜的电视机头歧骸维修师！
——身为「伊波恩」一员的欢腾冒险，向来都有精力无限的同伴的陪伴！
人际版图，从热闹的「半角街」开始拓展！勇敢结识更多登场的势力成员，随心增添你的「呗果」好友吧！
从街头店铺的和睦邻里到各有特色的猎人组织，更多奇闻轶事，只待「番外」为你娓娓道来，等你呼朋引伴，四方结缘！
【衣食住行，自由装点】
在你的都市自由探索，选择你熟悉的生活方式，又或大胆尝试些新花样吧！
自由改装你的爱车，在熙熙攘攘的街道上尽情驰骋，感受城市的脉动，又或是乘坐「幽灵号」在异象空间内自由穿行，「嗖」的一声，立抵目的地。
闲暇时刻，是先去「半角街」的老字号店铺逛逛，挑挑秘制的时令新品，还是购置自己的温馨小窝，更换你喜欢的装修风格？
倾听内心的声音、遵循自己的步调去感受吧，被你的信任拥抱的都市，终将回馈你以缤纷多彩、值得纪念的每一天。

critic.quote: NTE is a game that feels like it’s constantly pulling you in different directions, yet somehow still holds together as a cohesive experience. It wants to be a gacha RPG, a city life simulator, a driving game, a management sandbox, and a narrative-driven anomaly hunter all at once. And instead of collapsing under that weight, it actually becomes a strong foundation to support how its systems intera

If you like urban open worlds with life sim elements, then it’s impossible not to recommend NTE right now. This game has one of the most beautiful, vibrant sandbox settings I’ve seen in some time – and despite some irksome characters, I’m generally enjoying its plot so far, which blends slice of life mangas with sci-fi horror. The gacha business model is understandably not going to resonate with e

Neverness to Everness is an ambitious open-world gacha game overflowing with content, whose greatest strength lies in the city of Hethereau and the wide variety of activities it offers, ranging from exploration and management to combat. The gacha system is surprisingly generous compared to the standards of the genre and helps make the experience accessible even to free-to-play users, while the san

It’s a game that requires a lot of improvements before it can be truly great. I think that if you have the teeniest bit of curiosity, there’s nothing that should stop you from trying the game out for yourself. As a gacha game, its monetization isn’t aggressive, and playing it myself throughout this month was an experience I found decent, although it barely hits the passable bar. I’ll be closely fo

The audio department is less impressive, featuring music that serves a functional role within the gameplay—with a few tracks that actually manage to stand out—while the sound effects and voice acting (which we sampled in both English and Japanese) do little to push beyond the typical limitations of the genre, offering many stereotypical performances.

NTE: Neverness to Everness delivers a stylish and surprisingly varied gacha experience, packed with activities and strong presentation. While none of its systems truly stand out, the mix of vibes and accessible progression make it easy to sink hours into. The real test will be its long-term support, but for now, NTE has all the ingredients to become a lasting hit.

s.desc:
The Canon Keeper 是一款以叙事为核心的神学审查游戏，背景设定在一个反乌托邦未来。政府已经禁止《圣经》，销毁了几乎所有已知版本，并用经过篡改的经文来控制人们的信念。
玩家秘密协助一个试图用残存碎片重建《圣经》的抵抗组织。每天都会有经文碎片送到玩家桌前接受检查。有些是真实的，有些完全伪造，还有一些只改动了一个词，却足以改变整段经文的含义。
玩家需要检查每一份碎片，对照经文，使用参考工具，找出矛盾，并决定该经文应被批准、拒绝，还是标记以便进一步审核。你的决定会影响抵抗组织、收到这些经文的人，以及故事的发展。
The Canon Keeper 将叙事冒险、审查玩法、悬疑、推理与有意义的选择结合在一起。游戏的核心是紧张感、辨别力，以及在可靠信息被故意摧毁后判断真相所带来的后果。
本作为单人、剧情丰富的神学惊悚游戏，聚焦《圣经》、信仰、悬疑、决策以及反乌托邦抵抗故事。
如果您已经拥有本游戏的 PS4® 版本，则可免费获得 PS5® 数字版，无需再次购买本产品。PS4® 光盘版用户每次下载或游玩 PS5® 数字版时，都需要将光盘插入 PS5® 主机。购买 PS5® 数字版主机的 PS4® 光盘用户将无法免费获得 PS5® 版本。

本作深度改编自著名国民级IP《东北往事之黑道风云20年》。故事始于上世纪80、90年代东北暗流汹涌的街头，旧秩序正在改变。你，赵红兵，被卷入兄弟义气与地盘争夺的漩涡。与此同时，清纯如雪的高欢、泼辣似火的毛琴等红颜相继闯入你的生命；而情感的交织与江湖的算计接连上演。在权力与欲望面前，你的选择将彻底改写自己与他人的命运，走出独属于你自己的“道”
【金牌班底，原味再造】
由原著作者孔二狗亲自执导，确保剧情精髓；由互动影游制作人帝皇今指导制作。更有原班明星阵容回归，在尽可能保留原汁原味的基础上进行适当改编，为你带来电影级的真人互动影像，保证最纯正的“江湖”味与不一样的“东方热血”。
【正统IP，亲历江湖】
原著小说狂销 4000 万册，影视版豆瓣 8.8 分封神！但这一次，你不再旁观一段传奇，而是亲手点燃并书写属于自己的热血二十年。踏入80、90年代的东北江湖，在时代的烈焰与寒冰中，做出每一个足以燎原或覆灭的关键抉择。
【你的选择，就是江湖】
在游戏中，你将扮演 “赵红兵”，在跌宕起伏的人生里，做出一次次不同的选择。从为兄弟两肋插刀的义无反顾，到为生存低头隐忍的屈辱时刻，每个决定都将引爆截然不同的剧情分支。是成为一代枭雄的传奇？还是成为半途燃尽生命的悲歌？ 不同的热血结局等待你前来解锁。
【沉浸时代，细节复刻】
游戏以顶级美术工艺，复刻那个血液都滚烫的年代。从锈迹斑斑的老厂区到霓虹闪烁的夜总会，每一个场景都弥漫着粗粝而真实的热血气息。
【动态关系，鲜活群像】
与电视剧中经典角色的每一次相遇，都是一次命运的碰撞与热血羁绊的缔结。游戏“档案馆”系统让每个角色更加有血有肉，更有多条隐藏的、充满情义与背叛的人物线待你发掘。

欢迎来到终极可爱混乱游乐场。你将化身为一只调皮捣蛋的小猫咪，目标只有一个：把每个房间都变成你个人的完全破坏游乐场。从宽敞的郊区住宅到三个独特地点的阳光充沛的院子，你可以自由地跳跃、探索，随意敲翻每一件易碎物品。
做一只猫是份繁忙的工作。要完成你的日常任务，你需要追捕狡猾的老鼠、抓坏地毯，以及进行有趣无害的恶作剧来让你的主人们时刻保持警惕。在探索过程中，你可以收集隐藏的星星并赚取金币来解锁新的高度精细化房间，扩大你的领地。为了让冒险更加有趣，你可以解锁并扮演各种可爱的动物伙伴，并用一系列搞笑、时尚的帽子来装扮它们。拿起你的控制器，无视房屋规则，向世界展示一只小猫咪能惹出多大的麻烦！

经典生存恐怖
DERELIKT的氛围与结构受到《System Shock 2》《Alien Resurrection》和《Doom 3》的启发，着重营造装备不足、身陷超出自身能力范围的困境，以及远离一切援助时的恐惧。
有什么东西苏醒了
Von Neumann Outpost是一座偏远的研究站，建造于土星轨道上一颗废弃小行星的内部。如今，这里的走廊陷入黑暗，系统不断失灵，而仅存的少数幸存者却各自讲述着不同的故事。
探索逐渐崩溃的空间站
探索前哨站的秘密、走廊、实验室、维修通道和船员舱室。深入岩石内部更加诡异的区域。搜寻补给，解决环境谜题，并在这座越深入越危险的空间站中解锁新的路线。
不要完全相信任何人
空间站上仍有十多名NPC，每个人都有自己的问题、目的，以及对事件经过的说法。有些人需要帮助。有些人知道了不该知道的事情。有些人可能有用、危险、命中注定难逃一劫，或者三者兼具。
让每一发子弹都发挥作用
战斗紧张而富有满足感，你可以使用各种传统武器和外星武器。但每一发子弹都有代价。弹药、生命值和背包空间都十分重要。你拥有足以求生的火力，却不足以让自己感到安全。这不是一款让你肆意展现力量的线性射击游戏，而是一个令人不安、诡异且充满敌意的世界。
致敬90年代末的恐怖游戏
DERELIKT致敬早期3D恐怖游戏：扭曲的几何结构、厚重的氛围，以及挥之不去的不安感。游戏忠实而精美地重现了PS1美学，包括仿射纹理扭曲、动态细分、精心手绘的顶点颜色，以及全动态CGI过场动画。

critic.quote: DERELIKT is both a great nostalgic tribute to old-school gaming and a genuinely good title that stands out on its own. The worldbuilding is excellent, the gameplay is fun despite being intentionally dated, and the horror is genuinely strong without relying on jump scares. There is very little to complain about with DERELIKT, especially if you go in knowing that it was designed to feel like it coul

DERELIKT is a fun and intense throwback to the PS1 era that combines the atmospheric horror of Dead Space with the action and exploration of Half-Life. Its terrifying alien encounters, satisfying combat, and nostalgic presentation make exploring its infested research station a thrilling experience. While frustrating puzzles, occasional crashes, and gameplay bugs interrupt the fun, DERELIKT remains

A good old-school shooter and a convincing nostalgia trip, despite a few rough edges. DERELIKT will delight anyone who grew up with the claustrophobic adventures of the late '90s, offering a campaign that remains engaging from beginning to end, even if it occasionally feels a little too straightforward. A visual treat and enjoyable to play; an impressive achievement for a solo developer.
DERELIKT captures the heart and soul of the days of early 3D gaming, almost to a fault, delivering a game that can be frustrating and fun in equal measure.

s.desc:
在这款轻松悠闲的工作模拟游戏中，吹散落叶与烦恼。经营业务，购置新工具，解锁升级，同时欣赏落叶纷飞。毕竟，一个人的垃圾是另一个人的财富。
清洁小镇
体验《Leaf Blower Co.》的完整故事，清理杂物，重现宁静祥和的世界。当然，没人指望你免费干活！用辛苦赚来的钞票购置新装备、升级，甚至新风格。工欲善其事，必先利其器。要是你不动手，谁还会替你为垃圾桶换皮肤呢？
四季皆宜的工作
吹落叶这活儿可不全是阳光彩虹——毕竟就算大雨倾盆，学校操场上的落叶也得清理；网球场上突降的暴风雪，正是考验你的吹叶机性能的好机会；虽说镇长要求日落后紧急打扫他的花园有点反常，但你又怎能拒绝？
感受内心的宁静……
圆满完成工作后，真切地感受恢复宁静带来的满足感；全神贯注，吹走所有不合时宜的杂物；漫步于一系列温馨宜人的场景中，彻底放松身心。
……并探寻所有秘密
每个场景都设有可选奖励目标和隐藏彩蛋，犒赏你对每个角落的探索。需要敏锐的观察力和熟练掌握所有工具，才能找齐它们！
随心所欲地吹叶
完成剧情模式后，自由游玩模式将满足你的吹落叶瘾。自由选择心仪的场景、理想的天气和合适的时段。从海滩上白雪皑皑的清晨，到公园里辉煌绚烂的日落，一切由你掌控。按你的方式玩转《Leaf Blower Co.》！"

critic.quote: Leaf Blower Co. feels like an early-access game that’s nowhere near ready — buggy, poorly optimized, and, maybe worst of all, shallow and painfully repetitive.

s.desc:
恭喜你，新兵！你已被选中拯救人类，免遭庞大外星机械舰队的蹂躏。你的任务？登上母舰，摧毁一切移动的物体，并活到足以向他人汇报为止。你的装备？两条完好的手臂和数量多到离谱的枪械零件。欢迎来到《母舰：锻造》，这是一款VR Roguelite射击游戏，在这里，威力更大的武器、糟糕的决策和惊人的火力都是你工作的一部分。
打造你梦寐以求的武器，或者噩梦般的武器！直接抓取、组装武器组件到你的手臂上，创造出各种机械怪物，包括链式机枪、激光枪、火焰喷射器、榴弹发射器，甚至是爆炸披萨。超过万亿种可能的组合，让你能够建造出高耸入云、多管齐下的巨兽，足以让任何一位正经的武器工程师重新考虑自己的职业。添加护盾，尝试各种特殊改装，探索那些或许根本不应该存在的组合。
当然，母舰可不会在你组装最新杰作的时候乖乖待着。在遍布机械敌人的随机战斗房间里杀出一条血路，躲避如潮水般涌来的子弹，灵活地闪避、格挡、出拳，杀出一条血路。征服四个截然不同的地形，挑战巨型 Boss，收集升级道具，解锁新组件，为下一次挑战做好准备。与好友一起加入这场混战，体验双人在线合作模式，尝试多种挑战模式，或者挑战每日任务，赢取轮换的挑战奖励和排行榜。
在 PlayStation VR2 上体验机械狂潮！享受原生 120 FPS 的游戏体验（无需重投影），体验眼动追踪注视点渲染、头戴式触觉反馈（让你感受到击打的冲击）以及带有自适应扳机的 Sense 控制器反馈，让你的武器库栩栩如生。PlayStation Network 好友邀请、内置语音聊天功能以及包含白金奖杯在内的完整奖杯列表，众多挑战正等待着勇敢的玩家加入。
人类正指望着你呢。现在就去创造一些惊世骇俗的杰作吧。

Overall, Mothergunship: Forge comes out of the gate strong and gets more fun with each subsequent run.

Wear the headset and start shooting. And dodging. And creating absurd weapons. MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE is a pretty straight-forward roguelite shooter that delivers on its premise. It won’t do much more than that, but that’s fine, believe me.

MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE is a lot of fun. One of the best VR bullet-hell games I’ve experienced, it will have you ducking, bending and swiveling like a demon. It may lack variety and is best played in small doses (and big clear rooms), but If you like bullet-hell survival, and you’ve got a Meta Quest 2, this one is a title to check out.

While a different game from its prequel, Mothergunship: Forge is a great arena shooter with a strong challenge level.  It takes practice to get past that first boss and into the more ornate areas, but along the way you’ll unlock perks and new weapon parts to help each run get farther into the heart of the ship. The variance in parts is almost like stepping into a Lego store to build your ideal model. Get far enough and the guns can get ridiculous, filling the screen with components. Then again, that’s kind of the point. It would’ve been nice to have a s

users.quote: The joy of building an insanely huge weapon never disappoints. The game is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Multiplayer allows you to bullet hell with a buddy. Don't let pre-conceived dislike of wave shooters get you down--this is a real win for the VR platform and stands out from the rest.

s.desc:
与朋友和猴子一起体验混乱又刺激的拆弹乐趣！三名玩家组成一支合作小队，分别扮演失明、失聪和失语的猴子。每名玩家只能获得完成任务所需的一部分信息。互相沟通、解决谜题，并与时间赛跑。你们能在炸弹爆炸前将它们拆除吗？
• 3人合作： 不多不少，恰好需要三只猴子。
• 3种游戏模式：
o 战役： 30个精心设计的关卡，难度逐步提升。
o 无尽： 程序生成的波次关卡，难度不断增加。
o 自定义： 自由调整炸弹难度、计时器、模块类型、环境危险以及允许的失误次数，打造属于你们自己的挑战。
• 非对称角色： 每名玩家看到、听到和行动的方式都不一样。
• 趣味互动： 指指点点、挥手、做手势，或者疯狂挥舞手臂。你能做什么，只受想象力和每名玩家的表情轮盘限制。
• 扇巴掌： 显然，这是必不可少的功能。
• 全新环境： 我们都熟悉那辆可靠的小型面包车，但飞机呢？你们还能在哪些环境中拆弹？
• 环境危险： 应对停电、障碍物和嘈杂干扰等突发事件。
• 语音聊天： 有些人能说话，有些人不能。你们自己想办法吧。
• 谜题模块： 每枚炸弹都拥有不同的模块和规则，保证让你们陷入各种不同类型的恐慌。
• 关卡系统： 拆除炸弹即可解锁新关卡。你们越熟练，挑战就越困难。
• 色盲模式： 猴子看不见并不代表它不能拆弹！游戏中的物体和用户界面颜色经过调整，以支持两种不同类型的色盲。

critic.quote: Funny concept, polished mechanics, adorable graphics, and chill vibes even when everything’s about to blow. Bombanana is a blast no matter who you’re playing with or which monkey you’re playing as—as long as you have two other people to play with. Although guaranteed playability is limited by a strict multiplayer requirement and comes at three times the price, this is a one-of-a-kind co-op bomb de

Bombanana! is an original, delightfully zany, and absurdly addictive game—provided a few conditions are met: you need players who speak your language, are ready to have a good time no matter what, and are willing to accept that mistakes or misunderstandings can happen to anyone. It’s not for everyone—there are other cooperative games that don’t involve language barriers or the kind of pressure bui

users.author: HeySur
users.quote: Despite being another friend-slop, I enjoy the easy puzzles and teamwork with friends. The role that each monkey plays with each respectful gesture is fun because, no matter who you get, it is still enjoyable. Each new puzzle they introduce is a struggle, but studying and overcoming it is enjoyable. Overall, Friendsloop is not a cinematic game that everyone respects, but it still creates great memories. With that said, I want to give it 5/10, but the art style is different.

s.desc:
探索一个充满糖果的美丽世界。在精心设计的关卡中提升你的技巧，同时明智地收集并使用强化道具。
将三个或更多相同的糖果匹配并消除以通关，并尽可能利用特殊糖果！这款游戏带来的乐趣远超其他任何消除类游戏！
在各个关卡中收集虚拟货币（无需额外购买，靠实力赢取），并在“幸运轮”上试试手气。
《甜蜜糖果》将带给你数小时的欢乐时光！

users.author: HumanoidGREY
users.quote: Terrible Candy Crush ripoff that literally got stuck in the very first game I played. One of the gems got stuck in between 2 others and the whole field couldn't move anymore. Also absolutely horrible touchscreen response. I clearly swipe up and the game swipes left. Just avoid this one. If a developer can't even make a match 3 game, they are not worth your time.

s.desc:
从小做起，但要心怀大梦想。在 **House Cleaner Simulator** 中，你将接手住宅、办公室、车间、餐厅，甚至豪华庄园的清洁工作。随着每一处表面变得闪闪发亮，你的清洁事业也会不断发展，声誉节节攀升。
**游戏特色：**
* 解锁全新的拖把、高压清洗机、海绵以及其他专业工具
* 清洁更加豪华的场所，赚取名声与财富
* 提升角色等级，接手更具声望的合同
* 升级总部，扩大你的公司规模
* 获取新的工作车辆，接触更大型的客户
* 成为全城最出名的清洁达人！
无论是擦洗地板，还是用高压水流冲走顽固污垢，每一份工作都会让你离成为终极清洁大亨更近一步。**House Cleaner Simulator** 不只是一款游戏——它是一款完整的清洁事业模拟器，带来令人满足的游戏体验和无尽的成长空间。
拿起你的拖把，踏上登顶之路吧！

critic.quote: Cleaning is not a popular activity, but it works well on computer screens. But certainly not in this game.

s.desc:
Cats with Guns 是一款融入轻度肉鸽元素的 2D 休闲游戏。你可以在战斗中做出策略决策，让一只小猫咪成长为强大而威风的战士。强化你的猫咪，运用强力技能击溃敌军。凭借猛烈火力迎战数量庞大的敌人，逐一击败敌方将领，最终抵达喵托邦。
故事发生在喵托邦城郊。猫咪们曾在这里幸福生活，直到老鼠大军入侵，迫使它们背井离乡。如今，一群坚定的猫咪组成了“九命旅团”，誓要从鼠群手中夺回家园。你将穿越一波又一波敌人，最终迎战老鼠入侵军的首领。

奈菲莉娅从长达3000年的沉睡中苏醒。为了通过试炼、晋升为神，她必须逃出金字塔。但考验远不止于此：她收集到的宝藏和遗物将决定最终的命运。如果宝物足以证明她的资格，她就能成为掌管财富与幸运的女神，从此享尽荣华，化身好运的象征；否则，等待她的只有永恒的不幸与苦难。她的命运由你决定。
举起雕刻精美的石块，用念力让它们在空中移动，为自己搭建跨越尖刺、深坑和箭矢陷阱的道路。每间密室都是精心设计的谜题，考验你的平台跳跃技巧与智慧。找到隐藏的出口，继续深入金字塔。别忘了搜寻宝藏，以免迎来糟糕的结局。

m.title: Nefiriya and the Sands of Eternity

s.desc:
《Deadly Stakes》是一款暗黑风格的第一人称Roguelite游戏，其中赌博机制已成为一场致命医学实验的一部分。
你是一名被关在精神病院里的病人。为了获得出院许可，你必须经历一项又一项的“治疗”：操作诡异的赌博机、偿还不断累积的债务，并设法生存下来。
规则很简单：玩游戏、赢钱，并按时偿还债务。
听起来很简单。
直到你注意到天花板上的尖刺。
每一轮游戏起初都显得公平。转动老虎机、掷骰子、收集药丸，并逐渐将这些游戏机转化为为你效力的系统。购买奇特的医疗增强剂，改变赔率，提高派彩，触发重复激活，并将各种效果串联成能够彻底打破游戏平衡的连锁反应。
在这里，运气仅仅是起点。
你玩得越久，你的build就越强大——但你的债务也会随之增长。
《Deadly Stakes》特色：
两种不同类型的赌博机——老虎机和骰子游戏——各自拥有独特的规则和升级系统。
Roguelite 式奔跑，风险随你的实力增长而增加。
丰富多样的组合与协同效应，打造真正“破局”的build。
可反复获取并强化实验性能力。
两种相互关联的资源：金钱用于生存，药丸用于变强。
多个房间由统一的经济体系和共同目标联结在一起。
老旧精神病院令人窒息的氛围、医疗官僚体系以及强制性治疗程序。
《Deadly Stakes》并非一款赌博游戏。
头奖不会让你致富。
它只会为你争取到一点点时间。

帝国将陨是一款设定在柴油朋克世界中的回合制战术游戏。升级你的军队，指挥你的部队，然后利用地形，通过强大的力量和锐利的战术消灭敌人。
黑色帝国与蓝色联盟之间正在进行一场伟大的战争。这两个超级大国长期以来为统治权而斗争。在这款回合制战术游戏中控制任意一方，发起攻击，击溃对手！
受到经典作品的启发，《帝国将陨》采用基于网格的地图，操作简单易学。通过战略性地移动单位利用地形优势。选择你的立场——你会加入好战的黑色帝国，还是支持蓝色联盟的圣战？
特色：
- 非随机战斗。
- 多种单位类型，从坚韧的步兵到强大的坦克。
- 挑战你的战术技能的强大头目战。
- 热座多人游戏，支持在一台设备上挑战好友。
- 三个故事战役，包含手工设计的关卡，确保你需要智谋与力量并用才能成功。
- 可升级单位，具备特殊技能和弱点。

三只饥饿的山羊和一个坏脾气的山怪。三只小猪和一只呼呼吹气的大灰狼。还有一个好奇的小女孩，跟着一只金色蝴蝶来到三只熊的小木屋。
Story Time 是一款温馨的游戏，收录多部经典童话。每个故事都由手绘纸板木偶在玩具剧场里像电影一样精彩上演，并为孩子朗读全文；演出结束后，还有学习游戏和自然拼读等着孩子。
首发三个故事
Three Goats Gruff（三只山羊嘎啦嘎啦）、Three Little Pigs（三只小猪），以及加入原创情节的 Goldilocks and the Three Bears（金发姑娘和三只熊）：一只金色蝴蝶把金发姑娘带到小木屋，第二天她回来道歉，还修好了熊宝宝的椅子。
一起讲故事
每个故事都有完整配音，每个角色都有自己的声音。朗读时文字会逐一亮起，点一下任何单词就能再听一遍。孩子轻点屏幕来帮忙讲故事：帮山羊过桥，帮大灰狼吹气，陪金发姑娘尝尝粥、试试椅子和床。每一页还藏着一位小伙伴等你发现。
温馨的游戏室
菜单是一间小小的游戏室：放满故事书的书架、装着学习游戏的玩具箱、做自然拼读作业的书桌，还有奖杯柜。
学习游戏
每个故事都有记忆配对、故事问答、故事排序、比大小和单词游戏，还有一个动手搭建游戏：拼个山怪（Build a Troll）、盖座房子（Build a House）和煮锅粥（Make the Porridge）。每个游戏都有简单、中等和困难三个难度。
英语自然拼读
按教学顺序学习英语自然拼读（合成拼读法）的全部46个音。点一下就能听到读音，练习拼读和组合故事里的单词，看着单词收藏册一点点填满。
贴纸和奖杯
每个故事都有自己的贴纸册（Sticker Book）可以收集，一路上还能赢得奖杯。
照顾每位读者
易读字体、更大的文字和按钮、高对比度文字、更柔和的动画，所有说明都会朗读出来。
更多故事即将到来
更多故事正在路上，包括圣诞故事 The Night Before Christmas 和 The Elves and the Shoemaker，将作为追加故事推出。
无广告。本体游戏不含游戏内购买；追加故事另行单独销售。
请注意：本游戏为英文版（英式英语旁白、屏幕文字和自然拼读课程）。

店铺管理
设计您的店铺，兼顾效率与美观。规划商品陈列位置，管理货架布局，确保顾客享受流畅的购物体验。
补货管理
通过游戏内电脑下单采购。拆箱整理货物，将其分类存放于仓库，并摆放在货架、冷藏柜及冷冻柜中。
收银服务
扫描商品、处理现金与信用卡支付，确保顾客对购物及结账体验满意而归。
动态市场
应对实时市场的复杂变动。趁价格低谷采购商品，制定最佳售价以平衡顾客满意度与利润空间。
发展壮大
积累利润后可考虑再投资。扩建店铺空间，升级内部设施，持续适应零售业不断变化的需求。
个性化定制
打造独一无二的店铺。定制地板、粉刷墙面、设置分类标识等。
全城配送
并非每位顾客都会亲临门店。接收线上订单，打包商品，亲自完成配送。
采购本地市场
厌倦支付运费或四处寻找折扣？前往本地市场发掘最优货源。
清洁维护
让店铺焕然一新。擦拭地板、清运垃圾、擦亮窗户，保持环境一尘不染。
安全防护
并非每位访客都是顾客。安装监控摄像头与警报传感器，或雇佣保安人员防范偷窃行为。
多人协作
《超市模拟器》支持最多四位好友组队经营店铺。实时协作补货上架、接待顾客、处理网购订单、管理配送并拓展市场。从驾驶货车到清洁维护、定价策略，团队协作是打造成功超市的关键。
在《超市模拟器》中，每个决策都至关重要。你能否把握机遇，在平衡顾客满意度与财务状况的同时，将普通店铺打造成零售业巨头？

critic.quote: Supermarket Simulator is a Game Pass title that is oddly addictive. If you like sim games and playing with friends, this will tick many boxes. Although it is dated, I liked the core elements and the simple mechanics.

Supermarket Simulator is incredibly addictive, which is the hallmark of any good simulation game. It has that powerful “let me do just one more shopping day” appeal to it that could, and probably will, consume a hell of a lot of your time. Yes, it is a bit rough around the edges, but the core playability and the undeniable drive to make your supermarket the best in the neighbourhood are something

Grocery retail may seem like an odd subject for a sim game, but Supermarket Simulator absolutely pulls it off. It's seriously satisfying to see your store go from strength to strength, though it's a tad frustrating you can't delegate ordering.

s.desc:
建造、定制并经营你的梦想影院！安排电影场次、售卖门票、供应美味小吃，让顾客满意而归。拓展业务、升级设备，将一家小影院发展成娱乐帝国！
一起玩更精彩！
与好友组队，体验最多支持8名玩家的多人模式！分工合作，打理日常运营，一起经营影院。
掌控全场！
挑选影片、设定票价、雇用员工、升级设备并扩建影院。每个决定都很重要！
小吃与街机乐趣！
制作爆米花和棉花糖，然后稍作休息，与好友一起畅玩街机小游戏！
打造专属风格！
用家具和装饰自由定制你的电影院，打造心目中的完美影院。
认识猫咪！
可爱的猫咪在影院里四处闲逛！抚摸它们、为它们取名，享受它们的陪伴。
---
建造它、定制它、经营它、享受它——和朋友一起！
准备好掌控全场了吗？

穿越数十年时光，装饰芭比梦幻屋™，体验这场兼具舒适与创意的冒险，畅玩经典芭比游戏。进入《Barbie™ Rewind》的世界，你将在精美的像素艺术和复古风格中重温标志性的芭比时代。好闺蜜芭比邀请你进入她的世界，并委托你翻新她的梦幻屋。从芭比超过65年的历史长河中挑选各色物品，打造独特的风格。
从三种复古设计中为梦幻屋挑选外立面、墙壁和地板，你甚至可以在不同房间之间混搭。游戏中更有一系列从历年真实芭比玩具套装中汲取灵感的精美家具、装饰和配饰，帮助你为每个房间注入独特的风格。从经典的粉色梳妆台到90年代的充气椅，在梦幻屋中充分展现你独树一帜的风格与创意。
芭比还把她从1991年到2007年的16款芭比电子游戏收藏留给了你，其中包括《Barbie™Pet Rescue》、《Barbie™ Horse Adventures™: Blue Ribbon Race™》以及从未发行过的《Barbie: Vacation Adventure》。玩遍所有游戏，完成额外任务，解锁更多物品。
许多熟悉的朋友（肯、特蕾莎和克里斯蒂）也会来造访，请你帮忙为他们也设计一番。你还可以在精美的数字版时尚鉴赏画册中翻阅芭比的历史篇章。
游戏特色
- 装饰梦幻屋！多种多样的家具、装饰和配饰从历年芭比玩具套装中汲取灵感，丰富的选择供你布置芭比的梦幻小屋。
- 表达自我。超过250件家具、装饰和配饰可供解锁，拥有无穷可能。
- 畅玩16款经典芭比游戏。
- 芭比来电！她会引导你进行游戏，定期发布游戏更新与新任务。
- 独家数字版时尚鉴赏画册。翻阅芭比的历史篇章，了解最具标志性的梦幻屋和玩具套装背后的故事。

critic.quote: Featuring 14 classic Barbie games from the 90s and 00s, this is a solid and sizeable trip down memory lane – even if many of the games don't exactly stand the test of time. Like all Digital Eclipse collections, though, this has been nicely curated with plenty of extras – the all-new 'Let's Decorate' game being the real highlight.

It's another great effort from Digital Eclipse, and I think going the extra mile with the DreamHouse really lifts the whole thing. If you're nostalgic for Barbie games or are just curious about their history, this is a lovely way to experience them.

s.desc:
你把猫带去了工作地点。这可不是个好主意：半个超市的东西都散落在地上，每个货架都空了，而明天一早店铺就要开门。所以，卷起袖子干活吧。
捡起并上架
你要在超市里穿梭，从地上捡起商品并把它们放到对应的货架上：水果和蔬菜、饮料、冷冻食品、宠物用品、书籍等等。每上架一个正确的商品都会获得金钱，每填满一个货架格都会获得经验值。
技能
你可以在平板上购买技能，让工作更轻松：更强的携带能力、为你显示对应货架的货架查找器、把对应商品送到你身边的补货，或者 Dunk Shot，让你扔出的商品在命中正确货架时自动归位。
贴纸
每次升级时，你都可以为自己的收藏册从两张贴纸中选择一张。它们会带来金钱、更短的冷却时间或更长的技能持续时间。总共有十张可以收集。
猫咪
它会在店里闲逛，让你抚摸，还会时不时说一些几乎没一句是真的猫咪冷知识。与此同时，店长鲁迪·货架会给你发电子邮件，告诉你他对猫的看法。
没有时间压力
这里没有时钟，也不会失败。把商品放错货架不会有惩罚，只是不会计数。你的进度会被保存，你想什么时候继续都可以。而当最后一件商品回到它的位置时，你就能开店，并拿到一张列出你全部成绩的小票。

加入德国交通警察，在一个完全可驾驶的开放世界中维护道路安全：无限速高速公路、蜿蜒乡村公路和热闹的小镇。在 Autobahn Police Simulator 4 中，你将以前所未有的深度体验警察日常工作。开展交通拦截、保护事故现场，并在嫌疑人逃跑时展开追捕。
驾驶各种警用车辆在完全可驾驶的开放世界中巡逻，从标准巡逻车到便衣车辆一应俱全。设有休息站和加油站的高速公路与工业区、住宅区以及藏匿于森林和山间的小城镇交相辉映。
无线电呼叫响起，你来决定如何应对。无论是例行拦截、事故救援还是警灯鸣笛的高速追逐：每一次出警都带来新的挑战。依法执勤、出色完成任务可以积累声望、晋升警衔，并解锁新的车辆、装备和警察局。
Features:
■ 近距离体验德国交通警察的日常
■ 广阔的开放世界：高速公路、乡村公路、工业区和住宅区
■ 交通拦截并检查证件和车辆
■ 种类丰富的出警任务和无线电调度
■ 特殊行动和可选支线任务
■ 多个可解锁的警察局
■ 多种警用车辆，包括便衣车辆
■ 含可解锁内容的声望与进度系统
■ 改进的画面和更真实的驾驶物理效果

扫描与检查
你的主要任务是判断谁能进入俱乐部、谁不能。客人们会排队等候，你需要根据特定标准决定是否放行。有些客人可能会试图夹带违禁物品，找出这些隐藏的物品就靠你了。使用金属探测器、扫描仪等各种工具检查客人，揪出一切可疑之处。
清洁访客
给访客洗澡、去除纹身、泼水！
打造时髦发型
剪发、剃须，甚至还能让头发长出来！
买卖物品
游戏内设有商店，你可以购买新物品和工具，让游戏更加有趣。这些升级将帮助你提升安保技能，让工作更轻松。随着关卡推进，难度不断提升，你将面对更复杂的情况和更艰难的抉择。
尽情玩乐
对访客使用大量有趣又酷炫的道具，尽情享受吧！《I Am Security》考验的是你的快速反应和对细节的敏锐洞察。你能识破捣乱分子、守护俱乐部的安全吗？立即开玩，一探究竟！

Little Kite 是一款剧情向点击式冒险游戏，配有手绘画面与氛围音乐。故事围绕玛丽和年幼的儿子安德鲁展开，讲述一个家庭面对家暴与酗酒问题的经历。
扮演两位角色，探索残酷的现实与安德鲁的幻想世界，解开各式谜题。玛丽必须作出一个勇敢的决定，改变母子二人的生活。
游戏文字语言：英语、乌克兰语、荷兰语、俄语。无配音。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: Whilst Little Kite is certainly a worthwhile experience, it must be said that localisation isn’t a strong point with numerous grammatical issues including misspelt words and missing punctuation, but it certainly isn’t any reason not to jump into this fantastic story.

Little Kite will take you around 4 to 5 hours to complete, maybe less if you're clever and nail the puzzling situations. It’s a well created experience, and is great to see something tackle new and fervent ground in its subject matter. The artwork is amazing and the world created brilliantly realised, however the controls feel awkward at times and the speed of the cursor is annoying.

s.desc:
一款采用手绘美术的剧情向点击式冒险游戏。
惯犯 Oliver 因自己对家人造成的伤害而深感悔恨。他试图修复与前妻的关系，却屡屡失败，处境和对酒精的依赖也随之恶化。
一天，他在一家小商店目睹一名年轻女子实施抢劫。他看到了帮助他人、弥补过错的机会。但究竟谁需要帮助，谁才是受害者？
探索充满氛围的手绘场景，解开谜题，体验结局出人意料的故事。Repentant 部分延续了 Little Kite 的故事，但不了解 Little Kite 也可以游玩。
游戏内文本：英语、俄语、乌克兰语和荷兰语。语音：英语。游戏不支持中文。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: Although it sports some incredible artwork and a few interesting plot twists, Repentant doesn’t come close to achieving the heights of its predecessor, Little Kite.

s.desc:
《安全之地》是一款引人入胜的社交点击冒险游戏，深入探讨了童年的残酷现实和自我牺牲的复杂性。作为《小风筝》和《忏悔》创作者三部曲的第三部作品，这款游戏带领玩家踏上一段穿越命运羁绊角色生活的情感之旅。
故事发生在90年代初严峻经济危机中的后苏联城市，讲述了普通工程师亚历山大和有着坎坷过去的12岁女孩克里斯蒂娜的故事。一时的疏忽导致亚历山大意外杀人，而克里斯蒂娜成为唯一目击者。为了逃避后果，亚历山大隐瞒了罪行，并说服克里斯蒂娜保持沉默。作为交换，她要求他帮助解决自己的问题。从互惠互利的协议开始，迅速演变为一个充满道德抉择和意想不到后果的扣人心弦的故事。
游戏玩法融合了经典的点击解谜和戏剧性的情节反转，创造了一个强大的叙事体验，让玩家在同情与愤怒之间经历情感过山车。
警告： 本物品内容可能令人反感；不可将本物品派发、传阅、出售、出租、交给或出借予年龄未满18岁的人士或将本物品向该等人士出示、播放或放映。

critic.quote: The Safe Place is a compelling, expressive interactive tragedy. It contains an engrossing story brought to life by well-executed writing, graphics, music, and puzzles that will arouse the emotions of its players.

The gritty, realistic urban setting is stunning, but the story of The Safe Place is so drearily centered on poverty, crime and abuse that succeeding in cracking the more difficult inventory puzzles becomes more of a struggle than a pleasure just to progress and see more misery unfold.

s.desc:
踏入动荡的裂隙，在异界怪物的虎视眈眈下死里逃生，搜集各类诡秘原料，供给藏于英国酒吧地下的隐秘酿酒工坊。《危险等级》是一款支持1-4人游玩、物理驱动的合作生存恐怖游戏。越深入裂隙，越发怪诞诡异。切记，务必在酒吧打烊前赶回来。
1-4人联机生存，支持近距离语音
既可单人闯关，也能与至多三名好友共同直面裂隙中的重重恐怖。团队协作是生存关键，但活下去从来没有保证。游戏内置近距离语音聊天。
程序生成的裂隙次元
每一次远征，体验都截然不同。每一处裂隙都会生成全新生态区域、不断变化的地形布局、随机触发的危机，还有步步升级的致命威胁，逼迫整个小队随机应变。
基于物理的搜刮玩法
装备重力拳套，可一次性抓取、搬运、抛掷多件物品。采集裂隙孕育的奇异原料，前往裂隙站点换取报酬，同时还要躲避在各个次元四处游荡的恐怖怪物。
酿造特调饮品
辛苦工作一天后，带着异界原料回到布鲁巨龙的秘密酿酒坊，酿造各式饮品。完成订单，不断改良配方，提升饮品的效力。有些能赋予你强大的能力……另一些则会引发彻底的混乱。
为生存而战
每个次元都潜伏着骇人的怪物。观察它们的行为，摸清它们的弱点，巧妙运用武器，在致命遭遇中求得生机。判断何时迎战，何时保持距离。
裂隙扫描与传送门技术
使用先进裂隙扫描仪定位维度异常，部署裂隙稳定装置，撕裂开启极不稳定的传送门。迈步穿越，揭晓门后等待着你的未知存在。
狐穴酒馆
你的大本营是一间地道英式酒吧，“家族”的秘密研发设施就隐匿于此。远征间隙，你可以更换角色外观、调配增益特饮、查阅任务情报，或是往点唱机投币放松片刻。但千万别招惹酒馆老板。

《索尼克》降临《PICO PARK》！
《PICO PARK》系列是一款多人合作动作解谜游戏，而本次最新作《SONIC PICO PARK》将与SEGA经典作品《刺猬索尼克》展开联动！
《SONIC PICO PARK》是一款需要玩家彼此合作、共同闯关的2D动作解谜游戏！
游戏规则非常简单，只要所有玩家都成功到达画面右侧的终点即可通关。不过，想要抵达终点往往需要玩家之间紧密配合。互相协助、共同破解机关，才能顺利完成关卡挑战。
本次联动作品中，所有角色都能够使用《索尼克》系列的“旋转冲刺”动作。“金环”、“环形地形”、“弹簧”等经典元素也将悉数登场，让玩家在《PICO PARK》的世界中体验原汁原味的《索尼克》风格关卡。与伙伴们携手合作，突破重重难关吧！
与历代《PICO PARK》系列作品一样，本作支持2～8人本地及线上联机游玩，所有游戏内容均可根据不同人数进行体验。同时，线上模式还支持跨平台联机，让不同平台的玩家也能一同畅玩！
无论是与家人、朋友、恋人一起游玩，还是与来自世界各地的玩家在线协作，都欢迎前来体验这款融合《刺猬索尼克》与《PICO PARK》魅力的多人合作佳作！

critic.quote: Sonic Pico Park is a charming, bite-sized cooperative experience that does justice to both TECOPARK and SEGA's beloved franchise. Its simple puzzles emphasize communication and teamwork while paying a fitting tribute to Sonic's 35th anniversary. Despite its limited scope and low difficulty, it's a delightful choice for players looking for a fun, lighthearted experience to share with friends and fa

It's hard not to look at Sonic Pico Park as more Pico Park, but with a Sonic coat of paint. That's hardly a bad thing. I had a lot of fun with it, even if the fun was over quickly. It's a pick-up-and-play game, easy enough for anybody to get into without need for explanation. If anything, I'm slightly disappointed that there isn't more of it, because the Sonic the Hedgehog accoutrements add a lot

Sonic Pico Park is a delightful little puzzle game that blends quick, addictive multiplayer puzzles with a simple, charming aesthetic. I wish it had some single-player content, but playing with others is so fun that it makes the game worthwhile on its own.

Sonic Pico Park is a step up for the iconic puzzle-platformer. It adds a sense of style and quick-thinking that only Sonic could bring to Pico Park while giving an element of chaos not entirely new to Sonic, but elevated through the humor of Pico Park. The dedication and love to the Sonic series can be felt in everything it squeezes into its short run time, as well as how every single character’s

Sonic Pico Park is a fun and simple platform game to enjoy with friends and family. It's not challenging, making it perfect for relaxed sessions, especially with more casual players. However, the lack of a single-player mode and the game's length are two noticeable problems.

Sonic Pico Park is an intriguing crossover of two distinct concepts that, against all odds, just work together. It serves up the hilarious, chaotic challenges of Pico Park powered by the iconic characters, mechanics, and quirks of Sega's flagship franchise. While the content package feels a bit light on its own, the real fun kicks in the moment you jump into multiplayer.

s.desc:
结合了“指令PRG”×“双六”的恶魔般派对游戏！
为了夺回被“双六大魔王”占领的双六乐园，最多4人在地图上转动数字前进，在各种事件和战斗中获得胜利。
与伙伴同心协力打倒强敌“四天王”和“双六大魔王”！
……但是，能在游戏中获得胜利的，只有把打倒的头目带回来的那个人。
从打倒头目的瞬间开始，伙伴就变成对手。
要合作？还是背叛？最后展现胜利笑容的会是谁？
来吧，背叛派对开始了！

editions.name: 全民丢丢乐！普利尼双六大冒险

critic.quote: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! presents a hyper-specific gameplay formula that combines strategy RPG gameplay within a co-op board game so not everyone will click with it but those who do will have an absolutely wonderful time powering-up their characters, dood.
Prinny Party: Going Overboard! is a fun and chaotic time. Adding computer players adds another layer, as they seem to hate you making any progress.

Prinny Party: Going Overboard! has refreshing ideas and pleasant enough presentation, but the lack of a traditional online multiplayer mode really hurts its appeal. If you’ve got local pals who you can play with, you’re likely to have a great time messing with each other and taking on some iconic characters from throughout the main series, but otherwise, it’ll require a bit more patience than you

While there is a solidly-designed game at the center of Prinny Party!, both the presentation and amount of content are sorely lacking for its price point. Devoted Disgaea fans may find a party game worth the cover charge, but those who would quickly tire of a single board with only a few basic gimmicks may want to search elsewhere.

s.desc:
走进 Bulb Boy 奇妙又诡异的世界。两部广受好评的恐怖冒险作品首次合而为一，尽在 Bulb Boy Anthology。
认识 Bulb Boy：一个小小的发光英雄，脑袋可以拆下来，家人个个古怪，而且总是倒霉地被怪物包围。
在初代 Bulb Boy 中，可怕的黑暗吞噬了 Bulbhouse。Bulb Boy 从噩梦中醒来，发现家人失踪、家园被怪诞可怖的生物占领。探索房屋，解开奇异谜题，揭露令人不安的秘密，并利用 Bulb Boy 的特殊能力让光明重返家园。
接着在 Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair 中继续故事。Grandparaffine 派 Bulb Boy 去地下室寻找一罐珍贵的果酱，但一件无辜的小差事很快再次滑向疯狂。黏糊糊的果冻怪、扭曲谜题、恶心惊喜，以及一个对 Bulb Boy 脑袋格外感兴趣的恐怖生物，都在等着你。
Bulb Boy Anthology 将经典点击式冒险、解谜与恐怖元素，与超现实喜剧和极具辨识度的卡通风格融合在一起：怪诞、搞笑、恶心、迷人，偶尔还会让人毛骨悚然。
两部完整冒险
一次体验 Bulb Boy 与 Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair。 一路跟随 Bulb Boy，从 Bulbhouse 的黑暗走向其地下更加怪诞的深处。
美得恶心
独特的视觉世界汲取经典动画与 1990 年代卡通灵感，充满表情丰富的角色、离奇怪物和精心打造的恶心细节。 超现实环境让这个世界更加怪诞。
动动脑袋。字面意义上的。
Bulb Boy 的灯泡脑袋可以照亮黑暗、承受电击，甚至能从身体上拧下来，用来解决游戏中最怪异的问题。
谜题、怪物与秘密
探索非同寻常的环境，解决直观谜题，对抗可怕生物，并揭开 Bulb Boy 世界中隐藏的秘密。
没有对白的故事
动画表情、视觉叙事与 Bulb Boy 独特的气泡语言，无需传统对白也能让这个怪诞世界鲜活起来。
可爱。诡异。彻头彻尾的 Bulb Boy。
黑色幽默、恐怖、荒诞与意外的温情碰撞在一起，构成两段令人难忘的独立冒险。
找到你心中的光。
媒体对 BULB BOY 系列的评价
“几乎在每个方面都表现出色的绝佳游戏。”
— Adventure Gamers
“这款小型独立游戏确实是一颗宝石。”
— GamingTrend ★ 85/100
“风格异常鲜明的作品。”
— Rock Paper Shotgun
“迷人又古怪……依旧保持出色水准。”
— Nindie Spotlight ★ 8.1/10

《REZON》是 ALLUMER 于 1991 年发售的一款射击游戏。
外星人入侵期间，玩家将在地球上控制一艘配备 VAWS（Variable Armor & Weapon System）的 SR-91 战斗机并与入侵者作战。
拾取物品并装备武器，这是一项关键功能，可让您在使用得当时从身后攻击或阻挡敌人的射击。
《Arcade Archives》系列秉承忠实复刻经典街机游戏的理念开发，并搭载了难度与画面设置、回溯功能、连发模式及多存档位等便捷特性。玩家还可通过在线排行榜与全球玩家竞逐最高分数。
《Arcade Archives 2》在系列原有的“ORIGINAL MODE”、“HI SCORE MODE”、“CARAVAN MODE”基础上，新增“TIME ATTACK MODE”模式。在“TIME ATTACK MODE”中，玩家将不计分数全力竞速通关。新增的VRR（可变刷新率）支持功能，更能还原接近街机原版的流畅体验。
请尽情享受这些标志性的街机游戏吧！它们定义了一个时代，尽在“Arcade Archives”系列！

《SHOT RIDER》是SEIBU KAIHATSU公司于1985年推出的一款竞速游戏。
玩家将操控主角驾驶摩托车，在冲向终点线的途中撞击敌方车手将其淘汰。
赛道沿途设有岔路口，根据你的选择，可以体验高速公路、岩石路段和雪地赛道等多种赛道。
请注意避开汽车和障碍物，因为撞上它们会大幅消耗你的燃料。

*选项菜单和手册有日语，英语，法语，德语，意大利语和西班牙语。

*本游戏仅包含日语版。请注意，游戏内所有文字均为日语。
*选项菜单和手册有日语，英语，法语，德语，意大利语和西班牙语。
《Nobunaga Oda den》KOEI于1998年面向32位家用游戏机平台发行。
这款模拟角色扮演游戏生动再现了Nobunaga——这位开启日本近现代时代的伟人——的辉煌一生。
体验历史考据严谨的战斗场景，包括Okehazama之战、Inabayama之围以及Nagashino之战。
分支剧情系统：您选择的战术和战斗结果将引导历史走向不同的发展路径。
22位关键人物登场，包括Oda氏族成员、各诸侯国军阀以及文化名流。
通过分析情报并执行精准的战略来指挥盟军……
……尽情享受让《Nobunaga Oda den》栩栩如生的丰富游戏元素吧！
Nobunaga能否逃离Honno-ji的熊熊烈火，并最终结束Sengoku时代？
“Console Archives”系列秉承忠实复刻经典理念，将各代家用游戏主机上的杰作搬上现代平台，让玩家轻松畅玩。
本系列配备丰富便捷功能：支持自定义按键布局与画面设置，并可随时保存/加载进度。
无论您是昔日玩家还是初次体验，敬请尽情享受这些塑造家用机游戏历史的经典之作！

你曾坐在沙发上看新闻,对着电视骂骂咧咧,然后决定自己来干得更好。现在你有了一张办公桌、一支笔,还有一座对你抱有期待的小镇。
《Good President Simulator》是一款讽刺政治模拟游戏,以第一人称坐在办公桌前进行。法案落在桌上,访客带着各自的人情上门,而你签下的每一份文件,都会出现在明天的报纸上。
签字。或者不签。
每项法案都以纸质形式送来。拿起笔画下你的签名即可批准,或者驳回并把它揉成一团。每项法案都会用绿色和红色显示哪些阵营欢呼、哪些阵营暴怒,以及它对党的资金和公共资金造成的影响。没有哪项法案是免费的。
十五个阵营,只有一个你
社会主义者、资本家、环保人士、年轻人、安全部队、黑手党、阴谋论者等等。他们之间的友谊与仇恨彼此牵连,所以帮了一方的忙,就是冒犯另一方。如果整个阵营的支持度跌到零,他们会带着最后通牒来找你。把民调提高到50以上,你就能竞选下一个职位。
明天的头版
你桌上的报纸,是根据你昨天签署的内容写成的。读读他们怎么说你,然后继续工作。
一张会回应你的办公桌
访客走进来,递上法案,说出自己的诉求。有人带来雪茄、信封或礼物。拿了就等于接受。一切违法的事都靠口头解决,没有文件,也没有证据。忙完之后,关掉台灯回家。两项法案之间,揉皱的纸会扔进废纸篓,而废纸篓会替你记分。
付过钱的朋友
有人替你付了报名费。他们说自己是朋友。他们会来找你,他们背后的人也会。
从破屋到总统办公室
四个阶段:小镇、城市、大区和国家。赢下全国大选,输掉大选,被赶下台,或者落到更糟糕的地方:游戏共有21个结局,你的报纸为每一个结局都准备了头条。
承诺。签字。活下去。
游戏特色
- 第一人称办公桌模拟:笔、印章、台灯、废纸篓、铃铛和房门。
- 15个阵营,友情与恩怨交织成网。
- 四个阶段,四间不同的办公室。
- 21个结局,附结局图库。
- 完全支持DualSense无线手柄游玩。
- 45个奖杯加白金奖杯,部分为隐藏奖杯。
- 文字配有类似说话声的咕哝音效,没有配音。全程包含粗口和低俗幽默。

给植物浇水，给宠物喂食，不要关灯。
a pet shop after dark《天黑之后的宠物店》是一款用鼠标操作的恐怖冒险游戏。游戏里的你在一家小宠物店找了份奇怪的工作。店长告诉你这份工作很轻松——你所要做的仅仅是给植物浇水，给宠物喂食，然后过夜。
只须注意一件事——不论如何，都不要关灯。
特色
探索神秘的宠物店
给看不见的宠物喂食
给奇怪的植物浇水
以鼠标操作来解谜
注意
闪退是游戏的一部分。

《Thronefall》是一款极简主义策略游戏，你需要在白天建设自己的小小王国，夜晚抵御来袭之敌。加固城墙、招募单位，亲自冲锋陷阵，在经济与防御之间取得平衡，抵御源源不断的攻击者波次，守护你的要塞。
既可以快速游玩，也可以来一场防守马拉松，尽情享受流畅、可反复游玩且充满意外的塔防体验！
极简策略
• 10张地图。从群山环绕的北岩到生机盎然的野溪，逐步探索有不同地形、天气、敌人、建筑与挑战的多张地图。
• 9种可解锁武器。作为战士王者，你可以选择一样武器投入战斗，从战斧到血魔杖，应有尽有。
• 50多种可解锁特权。最多可携带5种特权以获得各种优势，还可选择变异以增加难度。
白天建设
• 用城墙、路障、神殿与塔楼守护你的王国。
• 通过房屋、桥梁、金矿、港口、磨坊与田地扩展经济。这些建筑只要能安全度过夜晚，每天清晨都会产出金币。
• 通过城堡中心、铁匠铺与皇家锻造厂研究升级。
• 利用兵营、射箭场与英雄居所组建军队。你的部队包括骑士、狂战士、弩手、火焰弓手，还有魔像与法师等特殊英雄。
夜晚防守
• 夜幕降临时，敌人便会接连来袭且越来越强，随时可能击溃你的王国。只有将敌人全部消灭，太阳才会升起。
• 木桶骑士、飞行法师、食人魔、史莱姆、黄蜂与投石机，大地危机四伏。
• 城堡中心被摧毁即代表你被打败。
• 身为国王，你需要亲临前线，守护你的小王国，直至太阳再度升起。

critic.quote: Chic, sleek, addictive, Thronefall is an artful gift to anyone who has been wanting to play a strategy game again for a long time, but who has struggled to integrate this often over-complex genre into their everyday lives. That's what makes it precious.

Thronefall has easily become my new favorite tower defense game, thanks to its solid mechanics and the absolute wealth of variety present in each aspect of the game. Countless difficulty mutations and enemies await you in this game, which gives new meaning to the word “replayability.”

Thronefall may be a minimalist strategy title, but it is big in heart and has a lot of depth to it. It is a game that is simple to play, but will challenge you at every turn. It is incredibly tough to put Thronefall down as it has that one more turn feel down to a tee. The challenge will be offputting for some, and there is a possible bug of enemies running around a wall, but other than that Thron

Thronefall pares back the usual tower defence formula into something simpler but still quite satisfying. Being forced to work with a predefined layout for your castle is a major limitation, and one that will frustrate some, but the perks and mutations system reintroduces just enough complexity to give Thronefall staying power. It also helps that the game looks great.

s.desc:
驾驶空中计程车，迅速且精准地翱翔于霓虹闪烁的夜空，将乘客安全送达目的地！《Skygrid Courier》是一款基于物理特性的动作解谜游戏，你需要控制飞船的动能，躲避障碍物，并在单萤幕构成的城市景观中安全抵达目标地点。一次接载一名乘客，飞往色彩对应的目的地，包括诊所、俱乐部、饭店和实验室。
运用快速思考的策略来规划路线，以免飞船电量耗尽，同时也要时刻留意护盾状态！如果撞击障碍物或飞越危险区域，一次糟糕的著陆可能就会让你的旅程戛然而止！你可以选择任务导向的「任务模式」来赢取奖励，在「街机模式」中争分夺秒，或是在「对战模式」中进行单机多人游戏。随著游戏进度推进，还能在机库中解锁各种奖励内容，包括不同外观与性能的飞船。你能否征服这座繁忙的霓虹未来都市？还是会坠毁收场？
• 在霓虹闪烁的城市景观中接送乘客！
• 善用飞船的动能，但别让自己坠毁！
• 完成任务即可获得奖励，并解锁全新的飞船！
• 在多种游戏模式中挑战你的操作技巧。
• 享受高画质 2D 风格的物理解谜游戏玩法！

你是金·卡特，一名恶名昭彰的亡命之徒，你的名声正如这片边境之地一样危险。
在寻找大买卖的过程中，你听说传闻中的“幽灵列车”正满载联邦黄金向你驶来。就是它了。
你迅速召集了一群亡命之徒，他们中有人擅长枪械，有人则拥有能让酒馆在瞬间变得死寂的超自然技能。
夜幕降临，帮派成员在幽灵般的月光映衬下策马出发行。你们齐心协力，将大草原变成了一片充斥着枪声和被猎杀者尖叫声的可怖土地。
但一旦登上列车，你就会发现它被称为“幽灵列车”并非浪得虚名。接踵而至的是你在《Hard West》未知荒原中的命悬一线的战斗，驱使你前进的是子弹、巫术，以及不计代价对个人救赎的追求。
追捕恶魔本人，夺回他偷走的东西——你的灵魂。
● 好人、坏人与不死者 西部民间传说与神秘学黑暗在这一片子弹与恶魔齐飞的无情土地上相撞。
● 征服黑暗边境 在拯救灵魂的绝望战斗中，探索大西部的每一个角落。从白雪皑皑的山峰到边境城镇，在残酷的世界中挣扎求生，并逐步揭开你帮派成员的秘密。做出冷酷的抉择，并承担随之而来的惨痛后果。
● 展示你的英勇 通过击杀敌人来激活“英勇状态”（Bravado State）并回复行动点。优雅地连击击杀多名敌人，延续你的连胜势头，巩固你作为传奇枪手的名声。
● 超级帮派 挖掘神秘的扑克牌来构建帮派的扑克牌组，为他们配备更强力的枪支、炸药、饰品，或者仅仅是一顿豆子加威士忌，让他们保持最佳状态。
● 超常领袖 无论你是否喜欢，这群由枪手、瞬间移动的巫师和其他神秘生物组成的帮派，其责任都落在了你的肩上。但要小心你的听取对象以及你的命令。正确的选择会带来忠诚度和新技能，而错误的选择则会考验他们的忠诚。
● 动态枪战 在充满铅弹和巫术的交锋中，回合制战斗发生在动态变化的环境中。从策马追逐到紧张的火车劫案，发挥你对西部的所有想象力，将你的战略技巧磨炼到极致。

critic.quote: Hard West 2 is a sequel we didn’t know we wanted. It’s XCOM-esque gameplay is enriched with the especially fresh mechanic of bravado, which leads to a completely unique approach at the shootouts. That’s no small feat for a subgenre where its rules of engagement are deeply embedded to the past.
From believable characters to the gritty, high-detail art style that seethes with atmosphere and the top-notch sound design, everything feels authentic in Hard West 2.

A very solid western turn-based strategy that doesn’t really fail at anything it’s trying to accomplish, even though the camera movements are capable of ruining a perfectly good fight and Native American culture should have been significantly more prominent.

Hard West 2 is a very solid and challenging turn-based strategy game, characterized by a beautiful story and some interesting adventure elements. That said, the difficulty level can be too hard, forcing you to proceed through a thousand trials and errors.

In no way would I ever recommend Hard West 2, but I have to be honest and say that I enjoyed myself. I just wish it didn’t come with a heaping bowl of curses. The developers should swallow their pride and listen intently to their customers, as I am sure I am not alone in my grievances. The team is clearly full of talented people who know how to create a good game, as long as they don’t get in thei

Hard West 2 is a classic game at heart with a progression system that is lacking. However, the fantastic western atmosphere, coupled with a neat narrative and combat that is both satisfying and varied in tactical situations, make the game a good pick up, both for fans of the genre and for those who would like to learn about turn-based strategy games.

s.desc:
浣熊推币机将经典街机推币机充满混乱的乐趣与肉鸽卡组构建类游戏的元素巧妙融合在一起。玩家可以将特制币与强力道具组合来触发令人爽到爆的联动效果。这是一场令人停不下来的多巴胺盛宴，一段不可预测、金币纷飞的刺激旅程！
代币协同 × 混沌暴击
在冒险过程中发现各式各样的特殊代币！将种子币与水滴币组合在一起，就能在机台里长出一棵摇钱树。投下橘猫币可将鼠鼠币一网打尽，并额外获得大量奖券。想要更多分数？用加加币可全面提高你的得分。进度太慢了？发射核弹币引爆全场，一口气将所有代币炸向前方！
利用道具打造强力策略
叠加倍率效果，生成带额外分数的代币，甚至在弹尽粮绝时猛摇整台机器，将代币都晃下来。为你最爱的代币镀上特殊镀层，强化效果，解锁更加疯狂的连击玩法。
多样角色，多种玩法！
选择多位各具特色的角色，每位角色都拥有专属主题代币与独特玩法风格。你可以化身擅长利用数学来打出爆炸连击的贪婪浣熊经理，又或是专精动物和植物代币玩出奇招的古怪生物学家。每个角色都能带来新鲜且截然不同的游戏玩法。

s.desc:
距离狸猫庆典只剩一个月，可神社却还是破破烂烂的。跟随心地善良但有点懒散的兼职邮差胖哒一路递送包裹，广结善缘，赶在庆典来临之前给神社来个大变样吧！
故事发生在某个闷热的夏季......
投送包裹
骑着小轮车在满是和风元素的狸猫岛上穿梭（这是个虚构的小岛哟），将信件和包裹投递给个性稀奇古怪的小镇居民们吧。这些包裹大小不一，重量和形状也都五花八门，所以出发前记得规划好投递路线哦！
寿司大厨，相扑选手，棒球达人！
随着你与镇民们日渐亲近，他们会请你为各种各样的活动搭把手。积极参加活动，就能获得形形色色的物品和奖励，帮助你重建神社。
整座岛都是你的游乐场（还是说……你就是传奇小轮车骑手胖哒·霍克！？）
骑上胖哒的BMX小轮车，用两个轮子探索整座小岛。飞跃坡道、沿着栏杆滑行，接连施展各种特技、打出连招，在探索新路线、挑战极限高度的同时，尽情享受骑行的乐趣！
翻修神社
夏末将至，你肩负着一项重要任务：为盛大的狸猫祭典做好准备！通过送货、参与各种活动和挑战100多项小轮车特技挑战赚取报酬，将这些收入投入狸猫神社的修缮与装饰中。尽情建造、升级，按照自己的喜好打造独一无二的神社吧！
临近狸猫祭典，胖哒不得不为了重修神社而东奔西走。快来帮他筹集经费、结识镇民、整饬神社，迎接一场此生难忘的盛大祭典吧！
化身狸猫邮差骑着越野自行车闯入小镇居民的心房！你必须在一个月内整修好神社，顺利举办盛大的狸猫祭典。送包裹、打比赛、捏寿司……更多好玩活动，尽在胖哒的夏日！

critic.quote: Tanuki: Pon's Summer is a charming, nostalgia-filled adventure that captures the magic of childhood summers through BMX exploration, quirky characters, and an impressive variety of mini-games. Its vibrant rural Japanese setting and fantastic soundtrack make every delivery feel like a new discovery. While limited BMX tricks and underdeveloped shrine customization leave room for improvement, Pon's s
Tanuki: Pon’s Summer takes a parcel-delivery game, centers it on a fantastic BMX traversal mechanic, and packs it to the brim with mini-games and side content.

This adorable adventure has clearly been made with a lot of care and attention, and that shines through in the engaging cycling gameplay and the endearing characters. Its mini-games do their best to hide the fact that the game's mainly a series of fetch quests, but the love that's gone into making it is contagious.

TANUKI: Pon's Summer turns a simple summer job into a charming adventure, with package deliveries, minigames and shrine restoration set in a colourful world full of memorable characters and a fantastic soundtrack. While the BMX controls can feel floaty, the limited trick variety and repetitive daily routine occasionally hold the gameplay back. Nevertheless, its undeniable charm and relaxing atmosp

s.desc:
沉浸在这舒适的氛围中，每个细微的动作和细节都值得用心感受。《焕家物语》是一款关于放慢脚步的游戏。没有计时器，没有分数，没有惩罚，也绝对没有压力。只有你、手中的工具，以及让一处处空间重现美丽的简单快乐。无论是擦拭窗户、粉刷墙壁，还是为沙发寻找一个绝佳的摆放位置，一切设计都是为了让你沉浸在从容而满足的节奏之中。
不用再面对琳琅满目的家具目录而无从下手。《焕家物语》为每个关卡精心挑选了风格协调的家具与软装，供你随心搭配。你可以自由摆放、旋转和布置物品——这里没有标准答案，每一处空间都将成为独一无二的创作。合理运用手头的工具，就能打造出媲美室内设计杂志的完美空间！
- 多种空间可供修缮与布置，不受任何限制，可以完全跟随你的步调重塑空间；未来更新还将带来更多关卡与季节活动
- 新游戏+与沙盒模式
-丰富多样的清洁与翻修工具，如拖把、玻璃刮、撬棍等
-基于物理的清洁玩法，带来深度满足感
-精心挑选家具与装饰，以达到风格协调，搭配美观
-由创意自由与游戏细节驱动，重玩性无穷
-多功能拍照模式，支持滤镜与高级镜头控制
-由《Stray》和《Seasons After Fall》作曲家创作的原声音轨，迷人动听

critic.quote: Hozy provides players with a short, relaxing, and expressive home renovation experience, giving you a cozy way to unwind at the end of a stressful day. If you love decorating and home renovation and want a compact take on the experience, Hozy is just the game for you.

For those looking for a video game that feels like a warm bath after a long day, Hozy is one to sink into. With versatility in design comes so much replayability. No pressure, no time limits, just a great game to relax with.

Hozy is a satisfying renovation sim that perfectly captures the cozy aesthetic. While the campaign is brief and the camera can be finicky, the core loop of transforming cluttered spaces is deeply rewarding. It’s an ideal, low-pressure choice for players looking to unwind through creative decoration.
“Cozy” and “cleaning” might sound like polar opposites, but Hozy’s cozy world provides the perfect cure-all for those looking to unwind with some spring cleaning.

Hozy is a laid-back and cozy game that’s a great way to pass the time. It strikes the perfect balance between freedom of self-expression and thoughtful, unobtrusive guidance, making it an excellent digital sanctuary in which to recharge your batteries.
If they built an entire game around the cleaning mechanics then I'd be there in a heartbeat, but there's still something undeniably lovely and calming about Hozy.
